# Athli - Complete Documentation

> Athli is an all-in-one coaching platform for fitness coaches to manage clients, deliver training programs, track progress, and grow their business.

Website: https://tryathli.com
Web App: https://app.tryathli.com
Help Center: https://docs.tryathli.com

---

# Welcome to Athli

## What is Athli?

Athli is an all-in-one coaching platform that helps fitness coaches manage their clients, build training programs, track progress, and grow their business. Whether you coach in person, online, or a mix of both, Athli gives you everything you need in one place.

## Why use Athli?

Running a coaching business means juggling a lot of tools. Spreadsheets for programming, messaging apps for communication, payment platforms for billing, and random apps for tracking. Athli brings all of that together so you can focus on what matters: coaching.

## Who is Athli for?

- **Personal trainers** managing multiple clients
- **Online coaches** who need a professional client experience
- **Gym owners** who want to offer digital coaching alongside in-person sessions
- **Strength and conditioning coaches** who need detailed programming tools
- **Nutrition coaches** who want to combine training and nutrition in one platform

## Key Features

### For Coaches (Web and Mobile)
- **Client management** with profiles, goals, and injury tracking
- **Workout builder** with drag-and-drop exercises and AI generation
- **Training programs** with multi-week scheduling
- **Check-ins and questionnaires** to collect regular client feedback
- **Habit and metric tracking** for accountability
- **Progress photos** with side-by-side comparison
- **In-app messaging** with file sharing and reactions
- **AI assistant** that can create workouts, search clients, and analyze data
- **Automation flows** to handle missed check-ins and workout reminders
- **Business tools** with packages, coupons, and Stripe payments
- **Client onboarding flows** for a professional first impression

### For Clients (Mobile App)
- **Daily training view** with guided workout sessions
- **Progress tracking** with charts and history
- **Check-in submissions** with forms and ratings
- **Habit logging** for daily accountability
- **Direct messaging** with your coach
- **Progress photos** with comparison tools

## Getting Started

1. [Create your account](02-creating-your-account.md)
2. [Invite your first client](03-inviting-your-first-client.md)
3. [Understand your plan](04-plans-and-billing.md)

## Need Help?

If you have questions that are not covered in these docs, reach out to us through the chat widget in the bottom right corner of the app. We are happy to help.

---

## FAQs

**Is Athli available on desktop and mobile?**
Yes. Coaches can use the web app on any browser and also have a mobile app. Clients use a dedicated mobile app available on iOS and Android.

**Can I try Athli for free?**
Yes. Athli offers a free trial so you can explore all the features before committing to a plan.

**Is my data secure?**
Yes. Athli uses industry-standard encryption, row-level security policies, and secure authentication. Your data and your clients' data are protected.

**Can I import my existing clients?**
Yes. You can add clients one by one or upload a CSV file with multiple clients at once.

# Creating Your Account

## What is this?

This guide walks you through signing up for Athli and setting up your coach profile for the first time.

## Why it matters

A complete profile helps your clients recognize you and builds trust. Your profile picture, name, and business details appear throughout the app when clients interact with your coaching.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### 1. Sign Up

1. Go to the Athli website and click **Get Started**
2. Enter your email address and create a password
3. Check your inbox for a verification email
4. Click the verification link to confirm your account

> [Screenshot: Sign up page with email and password fields]

### 2. Complete Your Profile

After verifying your email, you will be taken to the onboarding flow:

1. Enter your **full name**
2. Upload a **profile picture** (recommended: square image, at least 200x200px)
3. Select your **coaching category** (Online, Hybrid, or In Person)
4. Set your **timezone** so scheduling works correctly

> [Screenshot: Profile setup page during onboarding]

### 3. Set Up Your Business (Optional)

You can also configure your business details:

1. Go to **Settings > Business > Company Information**
2. Add your business name, logo, and description
3. This information appears on your public coaching page and client-facing materials

> [Screenshot: Business settings page]

### 4. Explore the Dashboard

Once setup is complete, you land on your **Home Dashboard**. From here you can:

- See today's client workouts
- View at-risk clients who may need attention
- Check your to-do list
- Access all features from the sidebar navigation

> [Screenshot: Home dashboard with summary cards]

## Things to Note

- You can update your profile at any time from **Settings > Account > Profile**
- Your email address is used for login and notifications. You can change it in **Settings > Account > Security**
- If you signed up with Google, your profile picture is imported automatically

## Common Problems

**I did not receive the verification email**
Check your spam folder. If it is still missing, try signing up again or contact support.

**I want to change my email address after signing up**
Go to **Settings > Account > Security** and update your email. You will need to verify the new address.

**My profile picture is not uploading**
Make sure the image is under 5MB and in JPG or PNG format.

---

## FAQs

**Can I sign up with Google?**
Yes. On the sign-up page, click the Google option to create your account using your Google credentials.

**Can I have multiple coach accounts?**
Each email address can only be linked to one account. If you need separate accounts, use different email addresses.

**Is there a mobile app for coaches?**
Yes. After creating your account on the web, you can download the Athli coach app and sign in with the same credentials.

# Inviting Your First Client

## What is this?

This guide shows you how to add clients to your Athli account so they can access their training, check-ins, and messaging through the client mobile app.

## Why it matters

Clients need an invite to join your coaching roster. Once invited, they get access to a dedicated mobile app where they can view workouts, log progress, submit check-ins, and message you directly.

## Use Cases

- Adding a new client who just signed up for your coaching
- Onboarding a group of existing clients from another platform
- Sending an invite link to a prospective client to get them started

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Method 1: Add a Single Client

1. Go to the **Athletes** page from the sidebar
2. Click the **Add Client** button in the top right
3. Fill in the client's details:
   - **Full name** (required)
   - **Email address** (required)
   - **Category** (Online, Hybrid, or In Person)
   - **Goals** and any relevant notes
4. Click **Send Invite**
5. The client will receive an email with a link to download the app and create their account

> [Screenshot: Add client side panel with form fields]

### Method 2: Upload Multiple Clients (CSV)

1. Go to the **Athletes** page
2. Click the **Upload** button (next to Add Client)
3. Download the CSV template if needed
4. Fill in your client details in the spreadsheet
5. Upload the completed CSV file
6. Review the imported data and confirm
7. All clients will receive invite emails

> [Screenshot: CSV upload side panel with template download]

### Method 3: Share an Invite Link

1. Go to the **Athletes** page
2. Click **Invite Link** to generate a shareable link
3. Copy the link and send it to your client via email, WhatsApp, or any messaging app
4. When the client opens the link, they are guided through creating their account and joining your roster

> [Screenshot: Invite link dialog with copy button]

## What Happens After the Client Joins

Once the client accepts the invite and creates their account:

1. They appear in your **Athletes** list with an "Active" status
2. You can start assigning workouts, programs, and check-ins
3. They can message you directly through the app
4. Their profile is ready for you to customize with goals, injuries, and notes

## Things to Note

- Clients need the Athli mobile app (available on iOS and Android) to access their training
- Each client needs a unique email address
- Your plan determines how many active clients you can have. Check **Settings > Billing** for your limit
- Archived clients do not count toward your client limit

## Common Problems

**The client says they did not receive the invite email**
Ask them to check their spam folder. You can also resend the invite from the client's profile page.

**I reached my client limit**
You may need to upgrade your plan or archive inactive clients to free up spots.

**The client created an account but does not appear in my list**
Make sure they used the same email address you invited. If they signed up independently, they will not be linked to your account automatically.

---

## FAQs

**Can clients use Athli on a web browser?**
The client experience is designed for the mobile app. Coaches use the web app.

**Can I remove a client?**
Yes. Go to the client's profile, then **Settings**, and choose to archive or remove them.

**Can a client have multiple coaches?**
Currently, each client is linked to one coach account.

**What information do I need to add a client?**
At minimum, you need their full name and email address. Everything else is optional.

# Plans and Billing

## What is this?

Athli offers different subscription plans based on how many clients you coach and what features you need. This guide explains the available plans and how to manage your billing.

## Why it matters

Choosing the right plan means you get all the features you need without paying for things you do not use. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Current Plan

1. Go to **Settings** from the sidebar
2. Click **Billing**
3. You will see your current plan, active client count, and billing cycle

> [Screenshot: Billing page showing current plan and client count]

### Upgrading Your Plan

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**
2. Click **Change Plan**
3. Select the plan you want to upgrade to
4. Review the pricing and confirm
5. Your new plan takes effect immediately

> [Screenshot: Plan selection page with pricing cards]

### Managing Add-ons

Some features are available as add-ons:

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**
2. Scroll to the **Add-ons** section
3. Toggle on any add-on you want (e.g., Payments)
4. The cost is added to your monthly bill

### Viewing Invoices

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**
2. Scroll to the **Invoices** section
3. Click any invoice to download a PDF

### Cancelling Your Subscription

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**
2. Click **Cancel Subscription**
3. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period
4. You can reactivate at any time before the period ends

## Things to Note

- Your free trial includes all features so you can explore before committing
- Archived clients do not count toward your active client limit
- Billing is handled through Stripe for secure payment processing
- You can update your payment method at any time through the billing portal

## Common Problems

**I was charged but my plan has not updated**
Billing updates can take a few minutes. Refresh the page and check again. If the issue continues, contact support.

**I want to downgrade but I have too many active clients**
You will need to archive clients until you are within the limit of the lower plan before downgrading.

**My free trial expired and I lost access to features**
Select a paid plan from **Settings > Billing** to restore access immediately.

---

## FAQs

**Can I switch plans at any time?**
Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle.

**Is there a discount for annual billing?**
Check the billing page for current pricing options. Annual plans may offer savings compared to monthly billing.

**What happens to my data if I cancel?**
Your data is preserved. If you resubscribe, everything will be there as you left it.

**Do my clients need to pay for the app?**
No. The client mobile app is free for your clients. Only coaches pay for the platform.

# Understanding Athli Plans

## What is this?

Athli offers three subscription tiers designed for coaches at different stages of their business. Each plan includes a base number of clients, and you can add more clients or features as you grow.

## Plans Overview

### Starter (Free)

The Starter plan is completely free and perfect for coaches just getting started.

**Includes:**
- Coach Mobile App (iOS and Android)
- Client Mobile App (iOS and Android)
- Workouts and Programs
- Training Calendar
- Exercise Library (1,700+ exercises)
- Client Messaging
- Up to 5 clients

**Best for:** New coaches testing the platform or those with a small client base.

### Pro (From $20/month)

The Pro plan unlocks the tools most coaches need to run their business effectively.

**Everything in Starter, plus:**
- AI Workout Builder
- Custom Exercises
- Custom Workout Sections
- Questionnaires
- Check-ins
- Habits and Metrics Tracking
- 5GB On Demand Files

**Best for:** Growing coaches who want advanced training tools and client tracking.

### Max (From $99/month)

The Max plan is built for established coaches managing larger client bases.

**Everything in Pro, plus:**
- Unlimited On Demand Files
- Broadcast Messaging
- AI Todo List
- Priority Support
- Lower extra client pricing

**Best for:** Full-time coaches or coaching businesses with many active clients.

## Client Slots

Each plan comes with a base number of clients included. If you need more, you can add extra client slots:

- Select the number of clients you want on the pricing page using the client slider
- Extra clients are billed per client, per month
- Max plan offers lower per-client pricing than Pro

> [Screenshot: pricing page showing client slider with "I want to coach" selector]

## Monthly vs Annual Billing

You can choose to pay monthly or annually:

- **Monthly:** Pay each month, cancel anytime
- **Annual:** Save 17% compared to monthly billing

Toggle between Monthly and Annual at the top of the pricing page to compare costs.

> [Screenshot: pricing page showing monthly/annual toggle]

## Add-ons

Add-ons let you unlock specific premium features on top of any paid plan:

### Automations
Automated onboarding sequences, custom trigger-based flows, scheduled actions and reminders, and multi-step automation chains.

### AI Assistant (Lyra)
Your all-round coaching assistant. Generate workouts and programs, track client progress, ask questions about your clients, and find clients who need attention.

### Payments
Collect payments from clients via Stripe. Includes packages and subscription management, automated payment collection, revenue analytics, and coupons.

Each add-on is billed separately and can be added or removed at any time from the billing page.

> [Screenshot: add-ons section on pricing page showing Automations, AI Assistant, and Payments]

## Free Trial

When you first sign up, you get a free trial that includes all features across all plans (including add-ons). This lets you explore everything before committing to a plan.

- Your trial countdown is shown on the billing page
- When the trial ends, you will need to select a plan to continue using premium features
- Starter plan features remain free forever

## Comparing Plans

To see a detailed feature-by-feature comparison:

1. Go to the pricing page (either from the marketing site or **Settings > Billing > Change Plan**)
2. Scroll down to **Compare Plans in Detail**
3. Review every feature and which plans include it

> [Screenshot: plan comparison table showing features across Starter, Pro, and Max]

## FAQs

**Can I start on Starter and upgrade later?**
Yes. You can upgrade to Pro or Max at any time. Your data and clients carry over.

**Do my clients pay anything?**
No. The client mobile app is completely free. Only coaches pay for the platform.

**What counts as an active client?**
Any client that is not archived counts toward your client limit. Archive inactive clients to free up slots.

**Can I try features before paying?**
Yes. The free trial gives you access to all features so you can evaluate before choosing a plan.

**Are prices in USD?**
Yes. All Athli pricing is in USD.

# Home Dashboard

## What is this?

The Home Dashboard is the first thing you see when you log in. It gives you a snapshot of what is happening across your coaching business today.

## Why it is useful

Instead of checking each client individually, the dashboard surfaces the most important information so you can quickly see who needs attention, what workouts are scheduled, and what tasks are pending.

## Use Cases

- Starting your day by reviewing which clients have workouts scheduled
- Spotting at-risk clients who have missed workouts or check-ins
- Checking completed workout summaries and client feedback
- Managing your daily to-do list

## Dashboard Cards

### Today's Workouts
Shows all client workouts scheduled for today. Each card displays the client name, workout name, completion status, and pre-workout metrics (sleep, mood, energy, stress, soreness) if the client has logged them.

> [Screenshot: Today's workouts card showing client workout cards with status indicators]

### At-Risk Clients
Highlights clients who may need your attention based on missed workouts, overdue check-ins, or declining engagement.

> [Screenshot: At-risk clients card with warning indicators]

### Completed Workouts
Shows recently completed workouts with client feedback and post-workout ratings. You can filter by status (completed, in progress, missed).

> [Screenshot: Completed workouts card with filter dropdown]

### To-Do List
Your personal task list. Shows both automated tasks from Athli (like check-in reviews) and custom tasks you have added.

> [Screenshot: To-do card with task items and checkboxes]

### Summary Cards
Quick stats at the top showing key numbers like active clients, workouts completed today, and pending check-ins.

> [Screenshot: Summary cards row at top of dashboard]

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing a Client's Workout Details

1. Find the workout card on the dashboard
2. Click on it to open the workout preview
3. You can see all exercises, sets, reps, and any notes the client added
4. Click **View Profile** to go to the client's full profile

> [Screenshot: Workout preview dialog with exercise details]

### Messaging a Client from the Dashboard

1. Find the client's workout card
2. Click the **Message** button
3. A quick message input appears
4. Type your message and send

> [Screenshot: Quick message input on workout card]

## Things to Note

- The dashboard updates in real time as clients complete workouts
- Pre-workout metrics (sleep, mood, etc.) are submitted by the client before starting their workout
- The to-do list syncs between web and mobile

---

## FAQs

**Can I customize what appears on the dashboard?**
The dashboard shows a fixed set of cards that are designed to surface the most important daily information. Custom dashboards are not available yet.

**Why are some clients not showing on the dashboard?**
Only clients with workouts scheduled for today appear in the workout section. At-risk clients appear based on engagement patterns.

**Can I see previous days?**
The dashboard focuses on today. For historical data, go to the individual client's profile.

# Client Management

## What is this?

The Athletes page is where you manage all your coaching clients. You can view, search, filter, add, archive, and organize your entire client roster.

## Why it is useful

As your coaching business grows, you need a central place to manage all your clients. The Athletes page gives you a bird's eye view of your roster and quick access to each client's profile, training, and progress.

## Use Cases

- Viewing all your active clients at a glance
- Searching for a specific client by name
- Adding new clients individually or in bulk
- Archiving clients who are no longer active
- Restoring previously archived clients

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Client List

1. Click **Athletes** in the sidebar
2. You will see a list of all your active clients
3. Each client card shows their name, profile picture, category, and status
4. Use the search bar at the top to find specific clients

> [Screenshot: Athletes page with client list and search bar]

### Adding a New Client

1. Click the **Add Client** button in the top right
2. Fill in the client's details (name, email, category)
3. Optionally add goals, notes, and other information
4. Click **Send Invite**
5. The client receives an email invitation to join

> [Screenshot: Add client side panel with form]

### Viewing a Client's Profile

1. Click on any client from the list
2. You land on their **Overview** page
3. From here, navigate to different sections using the tabs:
   - **Overview** - Bio, goals, injuries, recent workouts
   - **Training** - Weekly calendar with assigned workouts
   - **Check-ins** - Submitted check-in forms
   - **Habits** - Assigned habits and completion logs
   - **Metrics** - Custom tracked metrics with charts
   - **Photos** - Progress photos with comparison
   - **Exercise History** - Performance data per exercise
   - **Questionnaires** - Completed questionnaire submissions
   - **Files** - Shared documents and files
   - **Notes** - Private coaching notes
   - **Settings** - Client-specific settings

> [Screenshot: Client overview page with navigation tabs]

### Editing Client Details

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Edit** button (pencil icon)
3. Update their name, email, profile picture, category, or timezone
4. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Edit client details side panel]

### Archiving a Client

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click **Settings** in the navigation tabs
3. Click **Archive Client**
4. Confirm the action
5. The client will no longer appear in your active list and will lose app access

> [Screenshot: Client settings page with archive option]

### Restoring Archived Clients

1. On the Athletes page, click the **Restore** button
2. A panel shows all archived clients
3. Select the client(s) you want to restore
4. Click **Restore**
5. They regain access to the app immediately

> [Screenshot: Restore clients side panel]

### Uploading Clients via CSV

1. Click the **Upload** button on the Athletes page
2. Download the CSV template
3. Fill in your client data (name, email, category)
4. Upload the completed file
5. Review and confirm the import

> [Screenshot: CSV upload side panel with preview]

## Client Profile Sections

### Overview
The overview page shows a summary of the client including their bio, goals, injuries, and recent workout activity.

### Training
A weekly calendar view where you can assign workouts, apply programs, and see completion status for each day.

### Goals and Injuries
Track client goals (e.g., "Lose 5kg", "Run a marathon") and any injuries that affect their training.

## Things to Note

- Archived clients do not count toward your plan's active client limit
- Each client needs a unique email address
- Changing a client's email will require them to verify the new address
- You can resend invite emails from the client's settings page if they did not receive the original

## Common Problems

**A client is not appearing in my list**
Check if they are archived. Also make sure they accepted the invite and created their account.

**I accidentally archived a client**
You can restore them immediately from the Restore panel. Their data is preserved.

**The CSV upload is failing**
Make sure your file matches the template format exactly. Check for extra columns, special characters, or encoding issues.

---

## FAQs

**How many clients can I have?**
This depends on your plan. Check **Settings > Billing** for your current limit.

**Can I organize clients into groups?**
Client categories (Online, Hybrid, In Person) help you filter your roster. Custom groups are not available yet.

**Can I see when a client was last active?**
The client list shows activity indicators. You can also check the At-Risk section on your dashboard.

**Can I transfer a client to another coach?**
This is not currently supported. The client would need to be invited by the other coach separately.

# Training Programs

## What is this?

Training programs let you create multi-week structured plans that you can assign to clients. Instead of building each week from scratch, you design a program once and apply it to any client's training calendar.

## Why it is useful

Most coaching follows a structured progression. Programs save you time by letting you plan weeks of training in advance. When you assign a program, it automatically populates the client's calendar with the right workouts on the right days.

## Use Cases

- Creating a 12-week strength program for beginner clients
- Building a periodized plan with progressive overload across weeks
- Reusing the same program template for multiple clients
- Modifying a program for a specific client without affecting the original

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a New Program

1. Go to **Library > Training > Programs**
2. Click **New Program**
3. Enter the program name, description, duration (number of weeks), and difficulty
4. You land in the **Program Builder**

> [Screenshot: New program form with name, description, and duration fields]

### Using the Program Builder

The program builder shows a weekly calendar grid. Each column is a day and each row is a week.

1. Click on any day cell to add a workout
2. You can:
   - **Create a new workout** directly in the cell
   - **Add an existing workout** from your library
   - **Drag and drop** workouts between days
3. Use the **Insert Week** button to add more weeks
4. Click **Edit Details** to update the program name or description
5. Click **Save** when you are done

> [Screenshot: Program builder grid showing weeks and days with workout cards]

### Duplicating a Week

1. In the program builder, hover over a week row
2. Click the **Copy** icon
3. The week is duplicated below with all its workouts
4. You can then modify individual workouts for progressive overload

> [Screenshot: Week row with copy button highlighted]

### Saving a Workout to Library

If you build a workout inside the program builder that you want to reuse:

1. Click on the workout card
2. Click **Save to Library**
3. The workout is now available in your workout library

> [Screenshot: Workout card with save to library option]

### Assigning a Program to a Client

1. Go to the client's **Training** tab
2. Click **Assign Program**
3. Select the program from your library
4. Choose the **start week** and **end week** (you can assign the full program or just part of it)
5. Click **Assign**
6. The workouts populate the client's calendar automatically

> [Screenshot: Assign program side panel with week range selection]

### Editing a Client's Program

Once a program is assigned, you can still modify individual workouts for that client:

1. Go to the client's Training tab
2. Click on any workout day
3. Make changes (add/remove exercises, adjust sets/reps)
4. Changes only affect this client, not the original program template

## Things to Note

- Editing a workout in the program builder updates the template. It does not retroactively change workouts already assigned to clients
- Programs can be any number of weeks
- You can assign different programs to different clients at the same time
- Deleting a program does not remove workouts that have already been assigned to clients

## Common Problems

**I assigned a program but the client's calendar is empty**
Make sure you selected the correct date range. Also check that the program has workouts added to the days you expect.

**I want to change a program after assigning it**
Changes to the program template do not affect already-assigned workouts. Edit the client's individual workouts directly on their Training tab.

**The program builder is not saving**
Make sure all required fields are filled. Check for any unsaved changes before navigating away.

---

## FAQs

**Can I assign the same program to multiple clients?**
Yes. Programs are templates. You can assign them to as many clients as you want.

**Can I schedule a program to start in the future?**
Yes. When assigning a program, choose a future start date.

**Can clients see the full program or just the current week?**
Clients see their workouts week by week on their training calendar. They do not see the full program overview.

**Can I create a program with rest days?**
Yes. Simply leave those days empty in the program builder. Only days with workouts will show content.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"

# Workout Builder

## What is this?

The Workout Builder is where you create and edit individual workouts. You can add exercises, organize them into sections, set reps and weights, and even use AI to generate workouts automatically.

## Why it is useful

Building workouts is the core of coaching. The workout builder gives you a flexible drag-and-drop interface to create anything from a simple circuit to a complex periodized session with supersets, drop sets, and custom sections.

## Use Cases

- Building a new workout from scratch with specific exercises
- Using AI to generate a workout based on a description
- Organizing exercises into supersets, circuits, or custom sections
- Editing an existing workout to adjust volume or intensity
- Saving a workout to your library for reuse

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a New Workout

1. Go to **Library > Training > Workouts**
2. Click **New Workout**
3. Enter the workout name
4. You are now in the workout builder

> [Screenshot: Empty workout builder with name field at top]

### Adding Exercises

You have two options:

**Manual:**
1. Click **Add Exercise**
2. Search for an exercise by name or filter by muscle group
3. Click the exercise to add it
4. Set the number of sets, reps, weight, and rest time
5. Repeat for each exercise

> [Screenshot: Exercise search panel with filters and results]

**AI Generated:**
1. Click the **Athli AI** tab
2. Describe the workout you want (e.g., "Upper body push workout, 4 exercises, 4 sets each")
3. The AI generates a complete workout
4. Review and edit as needed

> [Screenshot: AI workout generation input with generated result]

### Creating Sections

Sections let you group exercises together (e.g., supersets, circuits, AMRAP blocks):

1. Click **Create Section**
2. Choose a section type (Superset, Circuit, AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata, etc.)
3. Drag exercises into the section or add new ones
4. Configure section-specific settings (rounds, rest between rounds, time cap)

> [Screenshot: Section builder with exercises grouped in a superset]

### Reordering Exercises

1. Hover over an exercise card
2. Click and hold the drag handle on the left
3. Drag the exercise to its new position
4. Release to drop

> [Screenshot: Exercise card being dragged to new position]

### Configuring Exercise Details

Each exercise card has columns you can customize:

- **Sets** - Number of sets
- **Reps** - Rep count or rep range (e.g., "8-12")
- **Weight** - Target weight or percentage
- **Rest** - Rest time between sets
- **Tempo** - Eccentric/pause/concentric timing
- **RPE** - Rate of perceived exertion
- **Notes** - Instructions for the client

> [Screenshot: Exercise card with expanded column options]

### Saving Your Workout

1. Click **Save** in the top right
2. If creating from a client's training page, the workout is assigned directly
3. If creating from the library, it is saved to your workout library

## Section Types Explained

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| Superset | Two exercises performed back to back with no rest between |
| Triset | Three exercises performed back to back |
| Circuit | Multiple exercises done in sequence as rounds |
| Giant Set | Four or more exercises back to back |
| AMRAP | As Many Reps As Possible in a time limit |
| EMOM | Every Minute On the Minute |
| Tabata | Timed intervals (typically 20s work, 10s rest) |
| Drop Set | Progressive weight reduction within a set |

## Things to Note

- You can customize which columns appear for exercises in **Settings > App > Customisations**
- The exercise library contains thousands of exercises with video demonstrations
- You can create custom exercises if yours is not in the database
- Workouts saved to the library can be reused across multiple clients

## Common Problems

**I cannot find an exercise in the library**
Try different search terms. For example, search "bench press" instead of "flat barbell bench press". You can also create a custom exercise.

**My workout is not saving**
Make sure you have entered a workout name. Check that all exercises have at least a name and the required fields filled.

**The AI generated workout does not match what I wanted**
Be more specific in your description. Include details like number of exercises, sets, muscle groups, equipment available, and difficulty level.

---

## FAQs

**Can I duplicate a workout?**
Yes. On the workouts list page, click the menu on a workout and select **Duplicate**.

**Can I add notes to the entire workout?**
Each exercise has a notes field. For a general workout description, edit the workout details.

**How many exercises can I add to a workout?**
There is no hard limit. Add as many exercises as your workout requires.

**Can clients see exercise demonstration videos?**
Yes. If the exercise is from the built-in library, clients see video demonstrations in the mobile app.

**Can I nest sections inside sections?**
No. Sections are one level deep. You cannot put a superset inside a circuit.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"

# Exercise Library

## What is this?

The Exercise Library is a searchable database of exercises that you use when building workouts. It includes thousands of built-in exercises with video demonstrations, and you can also create your own custom exercises.

## Why it is useful

Having a comprehensive exercise database means you spend less time describing movements to clients. Each exercise includes muscle group targeting and video demos so clients know exactly what to do.

## Use Cases

- Searching for exercises by name or muscle group when building workouts
- Adding custom exercises that are specific to your coaching style
- Browsing exercises to find alternatives or variations
- Viewing exercise details and demonstration videos

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Browsing Exercises

1. Go to **Library > Training > Exercises**
2. Browse the full list or use the search bar to find specific exercises
3. Filter by muscle group, equipment, or category
4. Click any exercise to see its details and video demonstration

> [Screenshot: Exercise library page with search bar and filter options]

### Creating a Custom Exercise

1. Go to **Library > Training > Exercises**
2. Click **Add Exercise**
3. Fill in the exercise name, target muscles, equipment needed, and category
4. Optionally upload a custom video or image
5. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Add exercise form with fields]

### Duplicating Exercises

1. Select one or more exercises using the checkboxes
2. Click **Duplicate Selected**
3. The copies appear in your library ready to edit

> [Screenshot: Exercise list with checkboxes and duplicate button]

## Things to Note

- Built-in exercises have professional video demonstrations sourced from MuscleWiki
- Custom exercises are only visible to you and your clients
- Deleting an exercise does not remove it from existing workouts
- Exercise videos play within the client mobile app during workout sessions

---

## FAQs

**Can I edit a built-in exercise?**
No. Built-in exercises are read-only. You can duplicate them and modify the copy.

**Do clients see exercise videos?**
Yes. When a client taps an exercise during a workout, they see the demonstration video.

**Can I import exercises from another platform?**
Not directly. You would need to create them manually as custom exercises.

# Check-ins

## What is this?

Check-ins are recurring forms that you assign to clients to collect regular feedback. Clients fill them out on a schedule (daily, weekly, etc.) and you can review their responses, track trends, and compare submissions over time.

## Why it is useful

Regular check-ins keep you informed about how your clients are feeling, recovering, and progressing. Instead of relying on clients to message you updates, check-ins create a structured feedback loop that makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

## Use Cases

- Weekly progress check-ins asking about training, nutrition, and recovery
- Daily wellness check-ins tracking mood, sleep, and energy
- Monthly body measurement submissions
- Post-program feedback surveys

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a Check-in Template

1. Go to **Library > Forms > Check-ins**
2. Click **Create Check-in**
3. Give it a name and description
4. Add questions using different types:
   - **Text** for open-ended answers
   - **Number** for measurements
   - **Rating** for scale-based feedback (e.g., 1-10)
   - **Yes/No** for simple binary questions
   - **Multiple Choice** for predefined options
   - **Scale** for slider-based input
5. Mark questions as required or optional
6. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Check-in builder with different question types]

### Assigning a Check-in to a Client

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Check-ins** tab
3. Click **Assign Check-in**
4. Select a check-in template from your library
5. Set the frequency (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly)
6. Choose the start date
7. Click **Assign**

> [Screenshot: Assign check-in dialog with frequency options]

### Reviewing Submissions

1. Go to the client's **Check-ins** tab
2. You will see a list of all submissions with dates
3. Click any submission to see the full responses
4. Use the **Compare** feature to view two submissions side by side
5. Use the **Download** button to export the data

> [Screenshot: Check-in submission detail page with responses]

### Comparing Check-ins Over Time

1. Open a check-in submission
2. Click **Compare**
3. Select another submission date to compare against
4. View the differences side by side

> [Screenshot: Check-in comparison view with two dates]

### Reviewing Check-ins from the Dashboard

1. Go to the **Check-ins** page from the sidebar
2. This shows all pending and recent check-in submissions across all clients
3. Click any submission to review it directly

> [Screenshot: Check-ins review page with submissions from multiple clients]

## Things to Note

- Clients receive a notification when a check-in is due
- You can edit check-in templates at any time, but changes do not affect already-submitted responses
- Check-in data is visible to both coach and client
- Automation flows can trigger actions based on missed check-ins

## Common Problems

**The client says they did not receive a check-in notification**
Check that push notifications are enabled on their device. Also verify the check-in frequency and start date.

**I want to change the questions on a check-in that is already assigned**
Edit the template in the Library. New submissions will use the updated questions. Past submissions are not affected.

---

## FAQs

**Can I assign multiple check-ins to the same client?**
Yes. You can assign different check-in templates with different frequencies.

**Can clients submit check-ins late?**
Yes. Clients can fill in a check-in after the due date.

**Can I see trends across multiple check-ins?**
Use the comparison feature to view two submissions side by side. Chart views may be available depending on the question type.

**Can I export check-in data?**
Yes. Use the Download button on any submission to export it.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Questionnaires

## What is this?

Questionnaires are one-time forms you send to clients to gather detailed information. Unlike check-ins which recur on a schedule, questionnaires are typically used for onboarding, assessments, or gathering specific data at a point in time.

## Why it is useful

When a new client joins, you need to learn about their history, goals, preferences, and any medical considerations. Questionnaires let you collect this in a structured format instead of a messy back-and-forth conversation.

## Use Cases

- New client intake forms collecting training history, goals, and medical information
- Pre-assessment questionnaires before program changes
- Feedback surveys after completing a program phase
- Dietary preference forms for nutrition planning

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a Questionnaire

1. Go to **Library > Forms > Questionnaires**
2. Click **Create Questionnaire**
3. Add a name and description
4. Build your questions (text, number, rating, yes/no, multiple choice, scale)
5. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Questionnaire builder with question types]

### Assigning a Questionnaire

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Questionnaires** tab
3. Click **Assign Questionnaire**
4. Select the template
5. Click **Assign**
6. The client receives a notification to complete it

> [Screenshot: Assign questionnaire dialog]

### Reviewing Responses

1. Go to the client's **Questionnaires** tab
2. Click on any completed questionnaire
3. Review all responses
4. Download the submission if needed

> [Screenshot: Completed questionnaire with responses]

## Things to Note

- Questionnaires are one-time submissions, not recurring
- For recurring feedback, use Check-ins instead
- You can include questionnaires in your onboarding flows for automatic assignment

---

## FAQs

**What is the difference between check-ins and questionnaires?**
Check-ins recur on a schedule (daily, weekly, etc.). Questionnaires are one-time submissions.

**Can I reuse questionnaire templates?**
Yes. Create once in the Library and assign to any client.

**Can clients edit their response after submitting?**
No. Once submitted, responses are final. The client would need to fill out a new questionnaire.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Habit Tracking

## What is this?

Habits are daily tasks you assign to clients to build consistency outside of training. Clients mark habits as complete each day, and you can track their adherence over time.

## Why it is useful

Great results come from consistent daily actions, not just workouts. Habit tracking helps you hold clients accountable for things like drinking water, sleeping 8 hours, eating enough protein, or taking supplements.

## Use Cases

- Assigning a "Drink 3L of water" daily habit
- Tracking sleep consistency with a "Sleep by 10pm" habit
- Monitoring nutrition habits like "Hit protein target"
- Building mobility routines with a "10 min stretching" habit

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a Habit

1. Go to **Library > Habits**
2. Click **Create Habit**
3. Enter the habit name, description, and category
4. Optionally organize into folders
5. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Create habit form]

### Assigning a Habit to a Client

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Habits** tab
3. Click **Assign Habit**
4. Select a habit from your library
5. Click **Assign**

> [Screenshot: Assign habit dialog with library selection]

### Viewing Habit Logs

1. Go to the client's **Habits** tab
2. You see all assigned habits with completion history
3. Click on a habit to see detailed logs
4. Use **Log a Habit** to manually log on the client's behalf

> [Screenshot: Habit tab showing completion calendar and log entries]

### Editing and Deleting Logs

1. Click on a specific log entry
2. Click **Edit** to update the value
3. Click **Delete** to remove the log
4. Confirm the action

> [Screenshot: Habit log entry with edit and delete options]

## Things to Note

- Clients can log habits directly from their mobile app home screen
- Habit reminders can be set up through automation flows
- Habits are organized in folders in the library for easy management
- You can see habit adherence rates in the client's profile

---

## FAQs

**Can I assign the same habit to multiple clients?**
Yes. Create the habit once in the library and assign it to any client.

**Can clients add their own habits?**
No. Only coaches can create and assign habits.

**Can I track partial completion?**
Habits are currently binary (done or not done). For more nuanced tracking, use metrics instead.

**How far back can I see habit history?**
All habit logs are stored and accessible from the client's Habits tab.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"

# Custom Metrics

## What is this?

Metrics are custom data points you define and assign to clients for tracking over time. Unlike habits (which are binary), metrics capture numerical values like body weight, body fat percentage, waist circumference, or any custom measurement.

## Why it is useful

Tracking numbers over time shows real progress. Metrics give you charts and history so you and your client can see trends, celebrate wins, and identify areas that need attention.

## Use Cases

- Tracking body weight weekly
- Monitoring body fat percentage monthly
- Recording custom measurements (arms, chest, waist, thighs)
- Tracking performance metrics like squat 1RM or sprint time
- Monitoring sleep hours or daily step count

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a Metric

1. Go to **Library > Metrics**
2. Click **Create Metric**
3. Enter the metric name and type (weight, measurement, percentage, count, time, or custom)
4. Set the unit of measurement (kg, lbs, cm, inches, etc.)
5. Add a description (optional)
6. Organize into folders if needed
7. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Create metric form with type and unit selection]

### Assigning a Metric to a Client

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Metrics** tab
3. Click **Assign Metric**
4. Select from your library
5. Click **Assign**

> [Screenshot: Assign metric dialog]

### Logging Metric Values

1. Go to the client's **Metrics** tab
2. Click **Log a Metric**
3. Select the metric and enter the value
4. The date defaults to today but you can change it
5. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Log metric form with value input]

### Viewing Metric History and Charts

1. Go to the client's **Metrics** tab
2. Click on any assigned metric
3. You see a chart showing the value over time
4. Below the chart is a history of all logged values
5. Edit or delete individual entries as needed

> [Screenshot: Metric detail view with chart and history table]

### Organizing Metrics into Folders

1. Go to **Library > Metrics**
2. Click **Create Folder**
3. Name the folder
4. Drag metrics into the folder or use **Move to Folder**

> [Screenshot: Metrics library with folders]

## Things to Note

- Clients can log metric values from their mobile app
- You can log values on behalf of your clients from their profile
- Metric data is preserved even if you unassign the metric
- Charts automatically adjust their scale based on the data

## Common Problems

**The chart is not showing data**
Make sure at least two data points are logged. A single value will show a dot but no trend line.

**I want to change the unit on an existing metric**
Edit the metric in the Library. Note that existing logs keep their original values, so changing units on a metric with existing data may look inconsistent.

---

## FAQs

**Can clients see their metric charts?**
Yes. Clients see their metric history and charts in the mobile app.

**Can I set target values for metrics?**
This feature is not available yet. You can note targets in the metric description.

**What is the difference between metrics and habits?**
Habits are binary (done/not done). Metrics track numerical values over time.

**Can I export metric data?**
Metric data is viewable in chart and table format within the app. Export functionality may vary by plan.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Progress Photos

## What is this?

Progress photos let clients upload photos on a regular basis so you can visually track their physical transformation. You can compare photos from different dates side by side.

## Why it is useful

Numbers do not always tell the full story. A client's weight might stay the same while their body composition improves dramatically. Progress photos give you visual proof of change that you can share with your client for motivation.

## Use Cases

- Monthly physique progress tracking
- Before and after comparisons for program evaluations
- Visual documentation for client testimonials (with permission)
- Tracking posture improvements over time

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Client Photos

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Photos** tab
3. You see a calendar or date-based list of uploaded photos
4. Click on a date to view the photos from that day

> [Screenshot: Photos tab with date-based photo grid]

### Adding Photos on Behalf of a Client

1. On the client's Photos tab, click **Add Photo**
2. Upload an image from your computer
3. Select the date
4. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Add photo dialog with upload area]

### Comparing Photos

1. On the Photos tab, click **Compare**
2. Select two dates to compare
3. Photos from each date appear side by side
4. Swipe or scroll between photos

> [Screenshot: Photo comparison view with two dates side by side]

## Things to Note

- Clients can upload photos directly from the mobile app
- Photos are stored securely and only visible to you and the client
- Image files must be under 5MB
- Supported formats: JPG, PNG

## Common Problems

**Photos are not uploading**
Check the file size (must be under 5MB) and format (JPG or PNG only).

**I want to delete a photo**
Open the photo and use the delete option. This cannot be undone.

---

## FAQs

**Can clients see their own progress photos?**
Yes. Clients can view and upload photos from their mobile app.

**Are photos backed up?**
Yes. Photos are stored securely in the cloud and accessible from any device.

**Can I download a client's photos?**
Yes. Use the download option on any individual photo.

**Can I compare more than two dates?**
The comparison tool currently supports two dates at a time.

# Messaging

## What is this?

The Inbox is Athli's built-in messaging system. It lets you communicate directly with your clients through text, images, files, audio messages, and reactions. All conversations are in one place so you do not need to use WhatsApp, email, or other apps.

## Why it is useful

Keeping all client communication inside your coaching platform means nothing gets lost. Messages are tied to client profiles so you have full context. You can also send broadcast messages to multiple clients at once.

## Use Cases

- Sending workout tips or motivation to individual clients
- Sharing nutrition plans or training documents
- Answering client questions about their program
- Sending broadcast updates to all clients (e.g., holiday schedule changes)
- Sharing images, videos, and files

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Sending a Message

1. Click **Inbox** in the sidebar
2. Select a client from the conversation list on the left
3. Type your message in the input field at the bottom
4. Press **Enter** or click **Send**

> [Screenshot: Inbox page with conversation list and message thread]

### Sending Files and Media

1. In a conversation, click the **attachment** icon
2. Select files from your computer (max 4 files per message)
3. Supported types: images, videos, documents, PDFs
4. Click **Send**

> [Screenshot: Message input with attachment options]

### Reacting to Messages

1. Hover over any message
2. Click the **reaction** icon
3. Select an emoji reaction
4. The reaction appears on the message

> [Screenshot: Message with emoji reaction selector]

### Replying to a Specific Message

1. Hover over a message
2. Click the **reply** icon
3. The original message is quoted above your input
4. Type your reply and send

> [Screenshot: Reply preview above message input]

### Sending a Broadcast Message

1. In the Inbox, click the **Broadcast** button
2. Select which clients should receive the message
3. Type your message
4. Click **Send to All**
5. Each client receives the message as an individual conversation

> [Screenshot: Broadcast side panel with client selection]

### Viewing Client Profile from a Conversation

1. In any conversation, click the client's name or avatar at the top
2. A profile panel slides out on the right
3. You can see their key information without leaving the chat

> [Screenshot: Chat with client profile panel open on the right]

## Things to Note

- Messages sync in real time across web and mobile
- Clients receive push notifications for new messages
- You can archive conversations to keep your inbox clean
- Message history is preserved even if a client is archived

## Common Problems

**Messages are not sending**
Check your internet connection. If the issue continues, refresh the page.

**The client says they did not receive my message**
Make sure they have the app installed and push notifications enabled.

**I accidentally sent a message to the wrong client**
You can delete individual messages by hovering over them and clicking the delete option.

---

## FAQs

**Can I send voice messages?**
Yes. Audio messages are supported.

**Is there a message character limit?**
There is no strict character limit, but very long messages may be better sent as files.

**Can I search through past messages?**
You can scroll through conversation history. A search feature may be available depending on your plan.

**Are messages encrypted?**
Messages are transmitted over HTTPS and stored securely. End-to-end encryption is not currently available.

**Can I message clients who have not accepted their invite yet?**
No. The client must have an active account to receive messages.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"

# AI Assistant: Complete Guide

## What is this?

The AI Assistant is an intelligent coaching helper built into Athli. It understands your client data, workout library, and coaching business. You can chat with it in natural language to create workouts, search clients, analyze progress, draft messages, and much more. Think of it as a senior coaching assistant that knows everything about your clients and can take action on your behalf.

## Why it is useful

Instead of clicking through multiple pages to build a workout, look up a client's metrics, or find who has been inactive, you can simply ask. The AI saves you time on repetitive tasks and gives you quick access to insights across your entire coaching business.

## Where to find it

- **Web app**: Click **Assistant** in the sidebar for the full chat page, or click the AI icon in the top navigation for a side panel
- **Mobile app**: Tap the **Assistant** option from the menu

## Full List of Capabilities

### Client Management

| What you can ask | What it does |
|---|---|
| "Search for Sarah" | Finds clients by name with their profile details |
| "Show me Sarah's profile" | Pulls up goals, injuries, category, and status |
| "List all my clients" | Shows your full active client roster |
| "Who has been inactive this week?" | Finds clients who missed workouts recently |
| "Add a goal for Jake: Run a 5k by March" | Creates a goal on the client's profile |
| "Add an injury for Sarah: Left knee strain" | Records an injury for training adjustments |
| "Update Jake's category to Hybrid" | Modifies client profile details |

> [Screenshot: AI finding inactive clients with results showing client names and days since last activity]

### Training and Workouts

| What you can ask | What it does |
|---|---|
| "Create an upper body push workout with 5 exercises" | Generates a complete workout with sets, reps, and rest |
| "Build a leg day focusing on quads and glutes" | Creates a targeted workout based on muscle groups |
| "Create a section: Superset with bench press and rows" | Builds a structured section with paired exercises |
| "Show me my saved workouts" | Lists workouts from your library |
| "Show me my programs" | Lists your training programs |
| "Show me my saved sections" | Lists your section templates |
| "Assign the Push Day workout to Sarah for Monday" | Assigns a workout to a client's calendar |
| "Search for hamstring exercises with dumbbells" | Finds exercises matching your criteria |
| "Browse the exercise catalog for back exercises" | Shows available exercises by muscle group |

> [Screenshot: AI generating a workout with exercise cards showing sets, reps, and rest times]

### Progress and Analytics

| What you can ask | What it does |
|---|---|
| "What are Sarah's latest metrics?" | Shows recent metric values and trends |
| "Show me Jake's check-in history" | Pulls up recent check-in submissions |
| "How is Sarah's squat progressing?" | Shows exercise history with weight and rep trends |
| "What are Jake's habit completion rates?" | Shows habit adherence data |
| "Analyze Sarah's progress over the last month" | Comprehensive progress analysis across workouts, metrics, and habits |
| "Generate a chart of Jake's body weight" | Creates a visual chart of metric data |

> [Screenshot: AI showing a progress analysis with metrics summary and trend indicators]

### Communication

| What you can ask | What it does |
|---|---|
| "Draft a message to Sarah about her workout today" | Prepares a message you can review and send |
| "Write a check-in reminder for Jake" | Drafts a friendly reminder message |
| "Send an encouraging message to Sarah about hitting her PR" | Creates a motivational message based on context |

> [Screenshot: AI showing a draft message card with edit and send options]

### Library and Templates

| What you can ask | What it does |
|---|---|
| "Show me all my check-in templates" | Lists your saved check-in forms |
| "What metrics do I have set up?" | Shows your custom metrics library |
| "Create a new check-in template for weekly progress" | Builds a check-in form with relevant questions |
| "Create a new metric for tracking waist circumference" | Sets up a new metric with units |
| "Assign the Body Weight metric to Jake" | Links a metric to a client for tracking |

> [Screenshot: AI creating a check-in template with suggested questions]

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Starting a New Chat

1. Click **Assistant** in the sidebar (web) or tap **Assistant** (mobile)
2. You land on a new empty conversation
3. Type your question or request and press Enter
4. The AI processes your request and responds

> [Screenshot: Empty assistant page with capability overview cards]

### Understanding Action Cards

When the AI proposes an action (like creating a workout or assigning a metric), it shows an **action card**:

1. The card shows the full details of what will be created or changed
2. Review the content carefully
3. Click **Confirm** to execute the action
4. Click **Edit** to modify the details before confirming
5. Click **Dismiss** to cancel

Action cards appear for:
- Creating workouts and sections
- Assigning workouts to clients
- Drafting messages
- Creating check-in templates and metrics
- Adding goals and injuries
- Assigning metrics to clients

> [Screenshot: Action card for a generated workout showing exercises with confirm and edit buttons]

### Chat History

1. The sidebar shows all your past conversations
2. Each chat has an AI-generated title summarizing the topic
3. Click any previous chat to continue where you left off
4. Click **New** to start a fresh conversation
5. Use the search bar to find specific chats by title
6. Delete chats you no longer need with the trash icon

> [Screenshot: Chat sidebar showing conversation history with titles and dates]

### Using the Side Panel (Web Only)

1. Click the **AI icon** in the top navigation bar
2. A chat panel opens on the right side of the screen
3. The AI has context about the page you are currently viewing
4. Ask questions related to what is on screen
5. This is useful for quick questions without leaving your current page

> [Screenshot: Side panel assistant open while viewing a client's training page]

### Viewing Tool Activity

When the AI is working on your request, you can see what it is doing:

1. Tool indicators appear showing which data the AI is looking up
2. For example: "Searching clients...", "Fetching workout data...", "Analyzing metrics..."
3. This transparency helps you understand how the AI arrives at its answer

> [Screenshot: AI processing with tool call indicators showing data being fetched]

## Example Conversations

### Quick Workout Creation
**You**: "Create a full body workout for a beginner, 6 exercises, 3 sets each, bodyweight only"
**AI**: Creates a workout card with exercises like squats, push-ups, lunges, planks, rows, and glute bridges with appropriate rep ranges.

### Client Check-up
**You**: "How is Sarah doing? Anything I should worry about?"
**AI**: Pulls Sarah's recent workout completions, check-in responses, habit adherence, and metric trends. Highlights any concerns like declining completion rates or missed check-ins.

### End of Week Review
**You**: "Which clients missed workouts this week?"
**AI**: Lists all clients who have incomplete workouts with the number of missed sessions.

### Program Planning
**You**: "Search for exercises that target the posterior chain using a barbell"
**AI**: Returns a list of matching exercises from the catalog with descriptions and muscle groups.

## Things to Note

- The AI has read access to all your coaching data (clients, workouts, metrics, check-ins, habits, exercises)
- It can create and assign content through action cards that require your confirmation
- It does not have access to your messages, billing information, or private notes
- Chat history is saved and persists across sessions
- AI usage may be limited based on your plan
- The AI generates a short title for each conversation automatically

## Common Problems

**The AI does not understand my request**
Try being more specific. Include details like client names, exercise names, number of sets, or date ranges.

**The AI gave incorrect data about a client**
The AI uses the data available in your account. If something seems wrong, verify the data directly on the client's profile page.

**Action cards are not appearing**
Not all requests result in actions. The AI shows action cards only when it detects something actionable. Try phrasing your request as a command: "Create a workout..." rather than "Can you tell me about workouts?"

**The AI is slow to respond**
Complex requests that involve looking up data for multiple clients may take a few seconds. The tool activity indicators show what the AI is working on.

**My chat history disappeared**
Make sure you are logged into the correct account. Chat history is tied to your user account.

---

## FAQs

**Is the AI assistant available on mobile?**
Yes. The AI Assistant works on both web and the coach mobile app with the same capabilities.

**Does the AI learn from my coaching style?**
The AI uses your client data and coaching context for each conversation. It does not permanently "learn" from past interactions, but your chat history is available for reference.

**Can the AI make changes without my permission?**
No. Every action requires your explicit confirmation through an action card. The AI cannot modify data without you clicking Confirm.

**Does the AI have access to my billing information?**
No. The AI only accesses coaching-related data.

**Can I undo an action the AI performed?**
Once confirmed, you would need to manually reverse the change (delete the workout, remove the goal, etc.).

**Is there a message length limit?**
Yes. Messages are limited to 10,000 characters. This is more than enough for any coaching request.

**Can the AI create training programs?**
The AI can create individual workouts and sections. Full multi-week program creation is planned for the future.

**Can the AI send messages to my clients directly?**
The AI drafts messages for you to review. You confirm before anything is sent.

**Is my conversation data private?**
Yes. Your AI conversations are only accessible by you. They are not shared with other users or used to train AI models.

**What happens if I am offline?**
The AI requires an internet connection to process requests. You cannot use it offline.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Automations (Flows)

## What is this?

Flows are automation rules that trigger actions when certain events happen. For example, you can set up a flow that automatically sends a message when a client misses a check-in, or creates a task when a workout is completed.

## Why it is useful

As your client roster grows, you cannot manually follow up with every client for every missed workout or overdue check-in. Automations handle the repetitive tasks so you can focus on coaching.

## Use Cases

- Sending an automated reminder when a client misses a check-in
- Creating a to-do item when a client completes a workout (so you can review it)
- Sending encouragement when a client finishes a tough workout
- Flagging clients who have missed multiple sessions in a row

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Flows

1. Click **Flows** in the sidebar
2. You see a list of available automation flows
3. Each flow shows its trigger event, actions, and active/inactive status

> [Screenshot: Flows page with list of automation flows]

### Activating a Flow

1. On the Flows page, find the flow you want to enable
2. Click the **toggle** to activate it
3. The flow starts running immediately for future events

> [Screenshot: Flow card with active toggle]

### Viewing Flow Details

1. Click on any flow to see its configuration
2. You can see the trigger condition, actions, and history of executions
3. Review recent activity to make sure it is working as expected

> [Screenshot: Flow detail page with trigger and action configuration]

### Requesting a New Flow

If you need an automation that does not exist yet:

1. On the Flows page, click **Request a New Flow**
2. Describe what you need
3. The Athli team will review your request

> [Screenshot: Request new flow button]

## Available Flow Types

- **Missed Check-in** - Triggers when a client does not submit a check-in by the due date
- **Missed Workout** - Triggers when a client does not complete a scheduled workout
- **Completed Workout** - Triggers when a client finishes a workout
- **Client Onboarding** - Triggers when a new client joins (see Onboarding Flows)

## Things to Note

- Flows run automatically in the background
- You can turn flows on and off at any time
- Flow history shows you exactly when each automation ran and what it did
- Flows are available on certain plans. Check your billing page for details

---

## FAQs

**Can I create custom flows?**
Currently, flows are predefined by the Athli team. You can request new flows using the request feature.

**Do flows work for all clients?**
Yes. Active flows apply to all your clients automatically.

**Can I customize the message that gets sent?**
Some flows allow message customization. Check the flow details for options.

**Will I be notified when a flow runs?**
You can see flow execution history on the flow detail page. Some flows create to-do items that appear on your dashboard.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Client Onboarding Flows

## What is this?

Onboarding flows let you create a structured welcome experience for new clients. When a client joins, the onboarding flow automatically assigns questionnaires, check-ins, programs, and sends welcome messages in a predefined sequence.

## Why it is useful

First impressions matter. A smooth onboarding experience makes clients feel taken care of from day one. Instead of manually sending forms and messages to each new client, the onboarding flow handles it automatically.

## Use Cases

- Automatically sending an intake questionnaire when a new client joins
- Assigning a starter program on day one
- Sending a welcome message sequence over the first week
- Setting up recurring check-ins after the initial onboarding period

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating an Onboarding Flow

1. Click **Onboarding** in the sidebar
2. Click **Create Onboarding**
3. Give it a name and description
4. Add steps to the flow:
   - **Assign questionnaire** at signup
   - **Send message** on day 1
   - **Assign program** after questionnaire is completed
   - **Assign check-in** on week 2
5. Set the timing for each step (immediately, after X days, after previous step)
6. Click **Save and Activate**

> [Screenshot: Onboarding builder with step sequence]

### Assigning an Onboarding Flow to New Clients

1. When adding a new client, select an onboarding flow
2. Alternatively, you can set a default onboarding in your settings
3. The flow starts automatically when the client creates their account

> [Screenshot: Add client form with onboarding flow selection]

### Monitoring Onboarding Progress

1. Go to the **Onboarding** page
2. You see all active onboarding processes
3. Each shows the client name, current step, and completion status

> [Screenshot: Onboarding page with active processes and progress indicators]

## Things to Note

- Each onboarding flow can have multiple steps with different timing
- You can create different onboarding flows for different client types
- Onboarding steps execute automatically based on the timeline you set
- You can pause or cancel an onboarding for a specific client if needed

---

## FAQs

**Can I have multiple onboarding flows?**
Yes. Create different flows for different coaching packages or client types.

**What happens if a client does not complete a step?**
The flow continues to the next timed step. You will be notified of incomplete steps.

**Can I edit an onboarding flow after activating it?**
Yes. Changes apply to new onboardings. Clients already in progress continue with the original flow.

# Business Packages and Payments

## What is this?

The Business section lets you create coaching packages, set prices, accept payments through Stripe, and manage your coaching business finances. Clients can purchase packages directly and pay you through the platform.

## Why it is useful

Getting paid should not be complicated. With Athli's built-in payment system, you can create professional packages, share them with clients, and receive payments without needing a separate payment platform.

## Use Cases

- Creating a monthly coaching subscription ($199/month)
- Offering a one-time 12-week transformation package
- Setting up different tiers (Basic, Premium, VIP)
- Managing client payments and viewing transaction history

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Connecting Stripe

Before you can accept payments, you need to connect your Stripe account:

1. Go to **Business** in the sidebar
2. Click **Connect Stripe**
3. You will be redirected to Stripe to create or connect your account
4. Complete the Stripe onboarding process
5. Once connected, you can start creating packages

> [Screenshot: Business page with Connect Stripe button]

### Creating a Package

1. Go to **Business > Packages**
2. Click **Create Package**
3. Fill in the details:
   - **Name** (e.g., "Premium Monthly Coaching")
   - **Description** of what is included
   - **Price** and currency
   - **Billing type** (one-time or recurring)
   - **Duration** for recurring packages (monthly, quarterly, etc.)
4. Click **Save**

> [Screenshot: Create package form with pricing options]

### Sharing Packages with Clients

1. On the Packages page, click **Preview Packages**
2. This shows the client-facing view of your packages
3. Copy the link and share it with clients
4. Clients can view your packages and purchase directly

> [Screenshot: Package preview page as seen by clients]

### Viewing Payment Activity

1. Go to **Business > Activity**
2. You see a list of all transactions, subscriptions, and payment events
3. Filter by date, client, or status

> [Screenshot: Activity page with transaction list]

### Managing the Stripe Dashboard

1. Go to **Business**
2. Click **Stripe Dashboard**
3. You are taken to your Stripe dashboard for detailed financial management
4. Manage refunds, disputes, and payouts from Stripe directly

## Things to Note

- The Payments feature requires the Payments add-on on certain plans
- Stripe handles all payment processing securely
- Athli does not store credit card information
- Payouts are managed through your Stripe account settings
- You can deactivate packages without deleting them

## Common Problems

**Stripe connection failed**
Make sure you complete all steps in the Stripe onboarding. If you have an existing Stripe account, make sure it is fully verified.

**A client cannot see my packages**
Check that the package is active (not deactivated) and that you are sharing the correct link.

**I want to refund a payment**
Process refunds through your Stripe Dashboard. Athli does not handle refunds directly.

---

## FAQs

**What percentage does Athli take from payments?**
Check the current pricing page for platform fees. Stripe also charges standard processing fees.

**Can I offer free trials before charging?**
Stripe supports trial periods on subscriptions. Configure this in your package settings.

**Do I need a business account for Stripe?**
No. You can use a personal Stripe account. Business accounts provide additional features.

**Can I accept payments in different currencies?**
Currency options depend on your Stripe account configuration and your country.

source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"

# Coupons

## What is this?

Coupons let you create discount codes for your coaching packages. Clients can apply these codes at checkout to receive a percentage or fixed amount off the price.

## Why it is useful

Coupons are a great marketing tool for attracting new clients, running promotions, or rewarding loyal clients. They work directly with your Stripe-powered packages.

## Use Cases

- Offering 20% off for new clients with code "WELCOME20"
- Running a holiday promotion with a limited-time discount
- Giving existing clients a loyalty discount for renewal
- Creating referral codes for clients who bring new business

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Creating a Coupon

1. Go to **Business > Coupons**
2. Click **Create Coupon**
3. Set the discount type (percentage or fixed amount)
4. Enter the discount value
5. Optionally set an expiry date or usage limit
6. Click **Create**

> [Screenshot: Create coupon form with discount options]

### Deactivating a Coupon

1. On the Coupons page, find the coupon
2. Click **Deactivate**
3. The coupon can no longer be used at checkout

> [Screenshot: Coupon list with deactivate option]

## Things to Note

- Coupons require Stripe to be connected
- Deactivated coupons cannot be reactivated. Create a new one instead
- Coupon codes are case-insensitive

---

## FAQs

**Can I limit how many times a coupon is used?**
Yes. You can set a usage limit when creating the coupon.

**Can I create a coupon for a specific client?**
Coupons are available to anyone who has the code. For a private discount, create a unique code and share it only with that client.

# File Sharing

## What is this?

The Files section lets you upload, organize, and share documents with your clients. You can share training plans, nutrition guides, contracts, or any other files your clients need.

## Why it is useful

Instead of emailing files back and forth, you can keep everything organized in one place within the client's profile. Clients can access shared files directly from their mobile app.

## Use Cases

- Sharing a PDF nutrition plan with a client
- Uploading a training contract for reference
- Providing educational resources about exercises or techniques
- Sharing meal prep guides or recipe documents

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Uploading Files to the Library

1. Go to **Library > Files**
2. Click **Upload** and select files from your computer
3. Organize files into folders for easy access

> [Screenshot: Files library page with folders and upload button]

### Sharing Files with a Client

1. Go to the client's profile
2. Click the **Files** tab
3. Click **Add Files**
4. Select files from your library or upload new ones
5. The client can now access these files from their mobile app

> [Screenshot: Client files tab with assigned files]

### Creating and Managing Folders

1. In the Files library, click **Create Folder**
2. Name the folder
3. Drag files into the folder or use **Move to Folder**
4. Click **Edit Folder** to rename or delete

> [Screenshot: Folder management with create and move options]

## Things to Note

- File size limits apply. Check your plan for specific limits
- Clients can view files but cannot upload files back
- Deleting a file from the library removes it from all client profiles where it was shared

---

## FAQs

Common formats including PDF, images (JPG, PNG), documents, and spreadsheets.

**Can clients download files to their device?**
Yes. Clients can view and download files from the mobile app.

**Can I share files with multiple clients at once?**
You would need to add the file to each client's profile individually.

# To-Do List

The To-Do section gives you a personal task list to manage your coaching work. It includes two views: tasks generated automatically by Athli (like check-in reviews), and your own custom tasks.

## Why it is useful

Coaching involves a lot of moving parts. The to-do list helps you keep track of things that need your attention so nothing slips through the cracks.

## Use Cases

- Reviewing check-in submissions that need your feedback
- Following up with a client about their program changes
- Remembering to create a new workout for next week
- Tracking administrative tasks like sending invoices

## Step-by-Step Guide

1. Click **To-Do** in the sidebar

3. You see tasks created by automations and flows
4. Complete tasks by checking them off

> [Screenshot: To-do Athli Assistant tab with automated task list]

### Managing Your Personal Tasks

2. Select the **Your List** tab
3. Click **Add Task** to create a new task
4. Enter the task description
5. Check off tasks as you complete them

> [Screenshot: To-do Your List tab with personal tasks and add button]
