Personal tasks are currently simple checkboxes without due dates.

No. The to-do list is for your personal coaching management. Use check-ins and habits for client-facing tasks.

# Business Sequences

Sequences let you automate a series of actions that run after a client purchases a package. Think of them as post-purchase workflows: when a client buys a package linked to a sequence, Athli automatically executes the steps you defined.

## What It Is

A sequence is a visual workflow built with a flow editor. You define a trigger (like a payment event) and then chain together actions such as sending a message, assigning a questionnaire, adding habits, or waiting a set amount of time before the next step.

## Why It Is Useful

- Automate client onboarding after purchase
- Ensure every new client gets the same welcome experience
- Save time by eliminating repetitive manual setup
- Create multi-step workflows with delays between actions

## Where to Find It

1. Go to **Business** in the sidebar.
2. Select **Sequences**.

> [Screenshot: sequences list page showing created sequences]

## Creating a Sequence

1. Click **Add Sequence**.
2. Enter a name and optional description.
3. Click **Save** to create the sequence.
4. You will be taken to the flow editor.

> [Screenshot: add sequence side panel with name and description fields]

## Using the Flow Editor

The flow editor is a visual canvas where you build your automation step by step.

### Triggers

Every sequence starts with a trigger. Available triggers include:

| Trigger | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Check-in completed | Fires when a client completes a check-in |
| Missed workout | Fires when a client misses a scheduled workout |
| Missed check-in | Fires when a client misses a check-in |
| Missed habit log | Fires when a client misses a habit log |
| Missed metric log | Fires when a client misses a metric log |
| Inactive for 7 days | Fires when a client has been inactive for 7 days |

### Actions

After the trigger, you add actions that execute in order:

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Send message | Automatically send a chat message to the client |
| Assign questionnaire | Assign a questionnaire from your library |
| Assign check-in | Assign a check-in form |
| Add file | Share a file with the client |
| Add habit | Assign a habit for tracking |
| Add metric | Assign a metric for tracking |
| Wait | Pause the sequence for a specified duration before continuing |
| Is check-in completed | Conditional check that branches based on completion |

### Building a Flow

1. Click the **trigger node** to select your trigger type.
2. Click the **+** button below to add an action.
3. Select an action type from the panel that appears.
4. Configure the action (e.g., select which questionnaire to assign).
5. Add more actions as needed, including **Wait** steps for delays.
6. Your changes save automatically.

> [Screenshot: flow editor with a trigger and multiple action nodes connected]

## Linking a Sequence to a Package

Once you create a sequence, you can link it to a business package so it runs automatically when a client purchases that package.

1. Go to **Business > Packages**.
2. Edit a package.
3. In the sequence field, select your sequence.
4. Save.

> [Screenshot: package edit form with sequence dropdown]

## Managing Sequences

From the sequences list, you can:

- **Search** sequences by name
- **Edit** a sequence by clicking on it
- **Delete** a sequence using the menu (note: sequences linked to packages cannot be deleted)

## FAQs

**Can I have multiple triggers in one sequence?**
Each sequence has one trigger. Create separate sequences for different triggers.

**What happens if I delete a sequence that is linked to a package?**
Athli will prevent deletion and show an error. Unlink the sequence from the package first.

**Can I test a sequence without a real purchase?**
Currently, sequences run when the trigger condition is met. You can test by simulating the trigger action (e.g., completing a check-in for a test client).

**Do actions run immediately or in order?**
Actions run in order from top to bottom. Use **Wait** actions to add delays between steps.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Client Notes

Client notes let you keep private records about each client. Notes are only visible to you as the coach and are never shared with the client.

## What It Is

A simple note-taking system attached to each client's profile. You can create, edit, and delete notes to track observations, session summaries, injury history, preferences, or anything else you want to remember.

## Why It Is Useful

- Keep a running record of client progress and observations
- Track important details like injuries, preferences, or goals
- Quickly reference past notes before a session
- Stay organized across many clients

## Where to Find It

1. Go to a client's profile (click on any client from your client list).
2. Select the **Notes** tab.

> [Screenshot: client profile with Notes tab selected showing list of notes]

## Creating a Note

1. Click **Add Note** (the + button).
2. Enter a title for the note.
3. Write the note content in the text area.
4. Click **Save**.

> [Screenshot: create note side panel with title and content fields]

## Viewing and Editing Notes

1. Click on any note in the list to open it in the side panel.
2. Edit the title or content directly.
3. Changes are saved when you confirm.

The notes list shows:
- Note title
- Creation date
- A preview of the content

> [Screenshot: note detail view in side panel with edit capability]

## Deleting Notes

**Single note:**
1. Open the note.
2. Click the delete icon.
3. Confirm deletion.

**Bulk delete:**
1. Select multiple notes using the checkboxes.
2. Click the delete button that appears.
3. Confirm deletion.

> [Screenshot: notes list with multiple notes selected and delete button visible]

## Tips

- Use descriptive titles so you can quickly scan your notes list (e.g., "Week 4 Check-in Summary" instead of "Note").
- Add notes right after a session while details are fresh.
- You can also access client notes from the inbox, so you can reference them while chatting.

## FAQs

**Can clients see my notes about them?**
No. Client notes are completely private to you as the coach.

**Is there a limit to how many notes I can create?**
No, you can create as many notes as you need per client.

**Can I search through notes?**
The notes list displays all notes for a client with titles and dates, making it easy to find what you need.

# Feature Requests

The Feature Requests page lets you submit ideas for new features, vote on suggestions from other coaches, and discuss improvements with the Athli community.

## What It Is

A built-in feedback board where coaches can propose new features, upvote ideas they care about, and have conversations through replies. The most popular requests help the Athli team prioritize what to build next.

## Why It Is Useful

- Share your ideas directly with the Athli team
- Vote on features that matter most to you
- See what other coaches are requesting
- Participate in discussions about proposed features

## Where to Find It

1. Click **Feature Requests** in the sidebar (or navigate to the Features page).

> [Screenshot: feature requests page showing list of requests with vote counts]

## Submitting a Feature Request

1. Click the **+** button to open the submission dialog.
2. Enter a title that clearly describes your idea.
3. Add a detailed description explaining the feature and why it would be useful.
4. Submit.

> [Screenshot: add feature request dialog with title and description fields]

## Voting on Requests

- Click the **upvote** button on any request to show your support.
- Click it again to remove your vote.
- Requests can be sorted by popularity to see the most-voted ideas.

> [Screenshot: feature request card with upvote button and vote count]

## Viewing and Replying

1. Click on any feature request to view its full details.
2. See all replies from other coaches.
3. Click **Reply** to add your thoughts or suggestions.
4. You can sort replies by newest or oldest.

> [Screenshot: feature request detail view with replies]

## Sorting and Searching

Use the controls at the top to:
- **Search** for specific requests by keyword
- **Sort by:** Newest, Oldest, Popular, or Yours (your own submissions)

## Deleting

- You can delete your own feature requests and replies.
- Click the delete icon and confirm.

## FAQs

**Who can see my feature requests?**
All coaches on the platform can see and vote on feature requests. They are community-wide.

**How does voting affect development?**
The Athli team uses vote counts and discussions to help prioritize the product roadmap. Popular requests get higher priority.

**Can I edit a feature request after submitting?**
Currently, you cannot edit after submission. Make sure your title and description are clear before submitting.

source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Section Builder

## What is this?

The Section Builder lets you create reusable workout sections in your library. A section is a group of exercises with a specific training format (regular sets, AMRAP, Tabata, HIIT, EMOM, or circuits) that you can save once and drop into any workout.

## Why is it useful?

- Build your go-to warm-ups, finishers, or circuits once and reuse them
- Keep your programming consistent across clients
- Save time by not rebuilding the same exercise combinations repeatedly
- Share standardized sections across programs and workouts

## Where to find it

1. Go to **Library** in the sidebar.
2. Select the **Training** tab.
3. Click **Sections**.

> [Screenshot: section library page showing list of saved sections]

## Section Types

Each section has a training format that determines how exercises are performed:

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Regular** | Standard strength training with sets, reps, and rest periods |
| **AMRAP** | As Many Rounds/Reps As Possible within a time limit |
| **Tabata** | High-intensity intervals: 20s work, 10s rest, 8 rounds |
| **HIIT** | High-intensity interval training with customizable work/rest |
| **EMOM** | Every Minute On the Minute with set duration |
| **Circuits** | Circuit training with a set number of rounds |

### Default Configurations

Some section types come with preset defaults:
- **Tabata:** 20s work, 10s rest, 8 rounds
- **HIIT:** 40s work, 20s rest, 10 rounds
- **EMOM:** 60s intervals, 10 minutes total
- **Circuits:** 3 rounds

You can customize all values when building the section.

## Creating a Section

1. Click **Add Section** from the sections library page.
2. Enter a name and optional tags for organization.
3. Select the section type (Regular, AMRAP, Tabata, etc.).
4. Add exercises from your exercise library.
5. Configure each exercise with sets, reps, weight, rest, or other relevant fields depending on the section type.
6. Save the section.

> [Screenshot: section builder with exercises added and type selected]

## Adding Exercises to a Section

- Click the **+** button to browse and add exercises from your library.
- Drag exercises to reorder them within the section.
- Create supersets by grouping exercises together.
- Use the AI generator to auto-fill a section from a text prompt.

> [Screenshot: exercise selection panel within the section builder]

## Configuring Exercises

Depending on the exercise type, you can set different fields per set:

- **Weight and Reps** - For strength exercises (e.g., 4x10 @ 80kg)
- **Reps Only** - For bodyweight or rep-based exercises
- **Distance and Duration** - For cardio exercises (e.g., 400m in 2:00)

Each exercise can have multiple sets with individual values. Use the link/unlink toggle to set all sets to the same value or customize each one.

> [Screenshot: exercise card showing set configuration with linked values]

## Using Sections in Workouts

Once saved to your library, sections appear when building workouts:

1. Open the **Workout Builder** (from a program, client training, or library).
2. Click **Add Section**.
3. Browse your saved sections and select one.
4. The section, including all exercises and settings, is added to the workout.
5. You can still customize it for the specific workout without affecting the library version.

## Managing Sections

From the sections library, you can:
- **Search** by name or filter by type and tags
- **Edit** any section by clicking on it
- **Duplicate** a section to create a variation
- **Delete** sections you no longer need (bulk delete supported)

> [Screenshot: sections list with filters and bulk actions]

## Tips

- Name sections descriptively (e.g., "Upper Body Warm-Up" or "5-Min AMRAP Finisher") so they are easy to find later.
- Use tags to categorize sections (e.g., "warm-up", "finisher", "legs").
- Build a library of sections for different training phases and reuse them across programs.

## FAQs

**What is the difference between a section and a workout?**
A workout is a complete training session. A section is a building block within a workout. One workout can contain multiple sections (e.g., a warm-up section, a main strength section, and a finisher circuit).

**If I edit a library section, does it update in existing workouts?**
No. Once a section is added to a workout, it becomes independent. Editing the library version does not change workouts that already use it.

**Can I use AI to generate a section?**
Yes. The section builder includes the same AI generation feature as the workout builder. Enter a text prompt and AI will suggest exercises and configuration.

**Is there a limit to how many exercises a section can have?**
There is no hard limit. Add as many exercises as needed for your training format.

source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"

# Managing Your Subscription

## What is this?

This guide covers everything you need to know about managing your Athli subscription: viewing your current plan, changing plans, updating billing, and handling scheduled changes.

## Viewing Your Current Plan

1. Click your profile icon in the bottom-left of the sidebar.
2. Select **Billing**, or go to **Settings > Billing**.
3. You will see a summary of your current plan including:
   - Plan name (Starter, Pro, or Max)
   - Number of clients included
   - Active add-ons
   - Monthly price
   - Billing interval (monthly or annual)
   - Trial days remaining (if on trial)

> [Screenshot: billing page showing current plan card with plan details and client usage bar]

## Client Usage

The billing page shows a progress bar indicating how many of your client slots are in use:

- **Green zone:** Plenty of room
- **Yellow zone:** Getting close to your limit
- **Red zone:** At or near capacity

If you reach your client limit, you will need to upgrade your plan or add extra client slots before inviting new clients.

> [Screenshot: client usage progress bar on billing page]

## Changing Your Plan

### Upgrading

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. Click **Change Plan**.
3. If you are on a trial, you will see a warning that selecting a plan ends your trial.
4. The pricing page opens with all available plans.
5. Select a plan, adjust client count if needed, and add any add-ons.
6. Review the summary on the right side.
7. Confirm and complete payment through Stripe.
8. Your new plan takes effect immediately, and confetti celebrates your upgrade!

> [Screenshot: pricing page in update mode showing plan cards with current plan highlighted]

### Downgrading

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. Click **Change Plan**.
3. Select a lower plan.
4. If you have more active clients than the new plan allows, you will need to archive clients first.
5. The downgrade is scheduled for the end of your current billing period.
6. You keep your current plan features until the change takes effect.

**Important:** Downgrades do not take effect immediately. You continue with your current plan until the billing period ends.

> [Screenshot: billing page showing "Changes scheduled" badge with current and upcoming plan cards]

### Scheduled Changes

When you have a pending plan change (like a downgrade), the billing page shows two cards:

- **Current Plan:** What you are on now, with the date it ends
- **Upcoming Plan:** What your plan changes to on the next billing date

You can cancel scheduled changes by updating your plan again before the effective date.

## Managing Add-ons

### Adding an Add-on

1. Go to **Settings > Billing > Change Plan**.
2. Scroll to the **Supercharge with Add-ons** section.
3. Click **Add to my plan** on any add-on (Automations, AI Assistant, or Payments).
4. The cost is added to your plan summary.
5. Complete checkout.

### Removing an Add-on

1. On the billing page, find the add-on in your current plan details.
2. Click the cancel option next to the add-on.
3. The add-on is scheduled for removal at the end of your billing period.
4. You keep access until then.

### Reactivating a Cancelled Add-on

If you cancelled an add-on but changed your mind:

1. Go to the billing page.
2. Find the add-on marked as "cancelling."
3. Click **Reactivate** to undo the cancellation.
4. The add-on continues as normal.

> [Screenshot: billing page showing an add-on with "cancelling" status and reactivate option]

## Viewing Invoices

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. Scroll to the **Invoices** section.
3. You will see a table with all your invoices showing:
   - Date
   - Period
   - Amount
   - Status (Paid, Open, Draft, Void)
   - Type (Subscription or Upgrade)
4. Click **View** to open the invoice in Stripe, or **PDF** to download it.

> [Screenshot: invoices table showing recent billing history]

## Billing from Mobile

You can also manage billing from the mobile app:

1. Open the Athli coach app.
2. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
3. This opens the billing page in a web view.
4. You can view your plan, change plans, and manage add-ons.
5. After completing a change, tap **Done** to return to the app.

## Payment Method

Payments are processed through Stripe. To update your payment method:

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. Look for the option to manage your payment method (this opens the Stripe customer portal).
3. Update your card or payment details.
4. Changes take effect for the next billing cycle.

## FAQs

**When does an upgrade take effect?**
Immediately. You get access to the new plan features right away.

**When does a downgrade take effect?**
At the end of your current billing period. You keep your current plan until then.

**Can I switch from monthly to annual billing?**
Yes. Go to Change Plan and select Annual billing. You will save 17% compared to monthly.

**What happens if my payment fails?**
Stripe will retry the payment automatically. If it continues to fail, your subscription may be paused. Update your payment method to resolve the issue.

**Can I get a refund?**
Contact support for refund requests. Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis.

**Do I lose my data if I downgrade?**
No. Your data is preserved. However, features from the higher plan will become unavailable until you upgrade again.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-web"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Cancelling and Reactivating Your Subscription

## What is this?

This guide explains how to cancel your Athli subscription, what happens when you cancel, and how to reactivate if you change your mind.

## Cancelling Your Subscription

### How to Cancel

1. Go to **Settings > Account > Danger Zone** (or **Settings > Billing**).
2. Click **Cancel Subscription**.
3. A confirmation dialog will appear explaining what happens next.
4. Confirm the cancellation.

> [Screenshot: cancel subscription confirmation dialog]

### What Happens When You Cancel

- Your subscription is **not cancelled immediately**. It is scheduled for cancellation at the end of your current billing period.
- You keep full access to all your plan features until the cancellation date.
- The billing page will show the cancellation date so you know exactly when access changes.
- No further charges will be made after the current period.

### After Cancellation Takes Effect

- You drop down to the **Starter plan** (free).
- Starter features remain available: workouts, programs, exercise library, messaging, up to 5 clients.
- Premium features (check-ins, questionnaires, habits, metrics, AI tools, add-ons) become unavailable.
- **Your data is NOT deleted.** Everything is preserved. If you resubscribe, all your data will be there exactly as you left it.
- If you have more than 5 active clients, you will need to archive clients to get within the Starter limit.

## Reactivating Your Subscription

If you cancelled but your billing period has not ended yet, you can undo the cancellation:

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. You will see a notice that your subscription is scheduled for cancellation.
3. Click **Reactivate**.
4. Your subscription continues as normal, and the cancellation is undone.
5. Billing resumes on the regular schedule.

> [Screenshot: billing page showing reactivate option for a subscription scheduled for cancellation]

### Resubscribing After Cancellation

If your subscription has already ended:

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. Click **Change Plan**.
3. Select your desired plan, client count, and add-ons.
4. Complete checkout through Stripe.
5. Your plan is activated immediately and all your previous data is still there.

## Cancelling Individual Add-ons

You can cancel add-ons without cancelling your entire subscription:

1. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
2. Find the add-on you want to remove.
3. Click the cancel option next to it.
4. The add-on is scheduled for removal at the end of your billing period.
5. You keep access to the add-on until then.

To undo an add-on cancellation, click **Reactivate** next to the add-on before the billing period ends.

## Deleting Your Account

Account deletion is separate from subscription cancellation:

1. Go to **Settings > Account > Danger Zone**.
2. You must cancel your subscription first if you have an active paid plan.
3. Click **Delete Account**.
4. Type the confirmation text to proceed.
5. Your account and all data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

**Warning:** Account deletion is permanent. Make sure you have exported any data you need before proceeding.

> [Screenshot: danger zone page showing cancel subscription and delete account sections]

## Timeline Summary

| Action | When It Takes Effect |
|--------|---------------------|
| Cancel subscription | End of current billing period |
| Reactivate cancelled subscription | Immediately (before period ends) |
| Cancel an add-on | End of current billing period |
| Reactivate cancelled add-on | Immediately (before period ends) |
| Resubscribe after cancellation | Immediately |
| Delete account | Immediately and permanently |

## FAQs

**Will I be charged after cancelling?**
No. Once you cancel, no further charges are made. You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

**Can I cancel during my free trial?**
If you are on a free trial, it simply expires at the end of the trial period. No payment is taken.

**What if I cancel by accident?**
Click **Reactivate** on the billing page before your billing period ends to undo the cancellation.

**How long is my data kept after cancelling?**
Your data is preserved indefinitely. You can resubscribe at any time and pick up where you left off.

**Can I cancel from the mobile app?**
Yes. Go to Settings > Billing in the mobile app, which opens the billing page where you can manage your subscription.

**Do my clients lose access when I cancel?**
Your clients keep the free Starter-level experience. Premium features you assigned (check-ins, habits, metrics) become unavailable to them as well.

source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "coach-mobile"

# Coach Mobile App Overview

## What is this?

The Athli Coach mobile app gives you access to your coaching tools on the go. You can manage clients, review workouts, message athletes, and check your schedule from your phone.

## Why it is useful

Coaching does not stop when you leave your desk. The mobile app lets you stay connected with clients, review their workouts between sessions, and handle quick tasks without needing a computer.

## Use Cases

- Checking a client's workout completion between gym sessions
- Responding to client messages on the go
- Reviewing check-in submissions during your commute
- Quickly looking up a client's profile before an in-person session

## What is available on mobile vs web

| Feature | Web | Mobile |
|---------|-----|--------|
| Dashboard | Yes | Yes |
| Client management | Yes | Yes |
| Training calendar | Yes | Yes |
| Workout builder | Yes | Limited |
| Program builder | Yes | No |
| Messaging | Yes | Yes |
| Check-in review | Yes | Yes |
| Habit tracking | Yes | Yes |
| Metric tracking | Yes | Yes |
| Progress photos | Yes | Yes |
| AI Assistant | Yes | Yes |
| Library | Yes | Yes |
| Business/Payments | Yes | No |
| Automations/Flows | Yes | No |
| Onboarding flows | Yes | No |
| Settings | Yes | Partial |
| To-do list | Yes | Yes |
| Feature requests | Yes | Yes |

## Things to Note

- Some advanced features like the program builder and business packages are only available on the web
- The mobile app syncs in real time with the web app
- Push notifications are managed through the mobile app's settings
- Download the app from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android)

---

## FAQs

**Do I need both the web and mobile app?**
No. You can use either one. However, the web app has more advanced features. The mobile app is best for quick tasks and staying connected on the go.

**Is my data the same on both?**
Yes. Everything syncs in real time between web and mobile.

**Can I build workouts on mobile?**
You can view and make basic edits to workouts on mobile. For building complex workouts with sections and drag-and-drop, the web app is recommended.

# Client App: Getting Started

## What is this?

The Athli client app is where you access everything your coach assigns to you. View workouts, submit check-ins, track habits, log metrics, message your coach, and monitor your progress all in one place.

## Why it is useful

Everything from your coach is in one app. No more searching through WhatsApp messages for your workout or trying to remember what your coach said about your check-in. It is all organized and easy to find.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Downloading the App

1. Go to the **App Store** (iPhone) or **Google Play** (Android)
2. Search for **Athli**
3. Download and install the app

> [Screenshot: App Store listing for Athli client app]

### Creating Your Account

1. Open the app
2. If your coach sent you an invite link, tap it to pre-fill your details
3. Enter your email and create a password
4. Complete your profile with your name and profile picture
5. You are now connected to your coach

> [Screenshot: Client sign up screen]

### Navigating the App

The app has tabs at the bottom for quick access:

- **Home** - Your daily tasks, workouts, and overview
- **Training** - Your workout calendar
- **Progress** - Metrics, photos, and history
- **Chats** - Messages with your coach
- **Profile** - Your details and settings

> [Screenshot: Client app home screen with bottom navigation tabs]

## Things to Note

- You need an invite from your coach to create an account
- The app requires an internet connection for most features
- Push notifications keep you informed about new workouts, messages, and check-ins
- You can enable biometric lock (Face ID or fingerprint) for extra security

## Common Problems

**I did not receive an invite from my coach**
Ask your coach to resend the invite email. Check your spam folder as well.

**The app is not loading**
Check your internet connection. Try closing and reopening the app.

**I forgot my password**
On the sign-in screen, tap **Forgot Password** and follow the steps to reset it.

---

## FAQs

**Is the app free?**
Yes. The client app is completely free. Your coach pays for the platform.

**Can I use the app on a tablet?**
The app is designed for phones but works on tablets as well.

**Can I have multiple coaches?**
Currently, each account is linked to one coach.

**Can I use the app without a coach?**
No. You need an invite from a coach to create an account and access features.

# Client App: Home Screen

## What is this?

The Home screen is the first thing you see when you open the app. It shows your daily overview including today's workout, pending check-ins, habit reminders, and any messages from your coach.

## Why it is useful

Instead of navigating through different sections to figure out what you need to do today, the Home screen puts everything in one place. Open the app, see what is on your plate, and get started.

## Use Cases

- Checking what workout is scheduled for today
- Seeing if you have any pending check-ins to submit
- Reviewing habit reminders for the day
- Quickly jumping to a message from your coach

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Daily Workout

1. Open the app to the **Home** tab
2. Your scheduled workout for today is displayed prominently
3. It shows the workout name, number of exercises, and estimated duration
4. Tap the workout card to start your session or preview the exercises

> [Screenshot: Client home screen with today's workout card highlighted]

### Checking Pending Tasks

1. Below the workout card, you will see any pending items:
   - Check-ins that are due
   - Habits to log
   - Questionnaires to complete
2. Tap any item to go directly to it

> [Screenshot: Home screen showing pending check-in and habit reminders]

### Viewing Pre-Workout Metrics

Before starting a workout, you may be asked to rate how you are feeling:

1. Tap the workout card
2. Before the session starts, rate your **sleep**, **mood**, **energy**, **stress**, and **soreness**
3. These ratings help your coach understand how you are feeling and adjust your training

> [Screenshot: Pre-workout metrics screen with rating sliders]

### Quick Actions

The Home screen may include quick action buttons for:

- Starting today's workout
- Sending a message to your coach
- Logging a habit
- Taking a progress photo

> [Screenshot: Quick action buttons on home screen]

## Things to Note

- The Home screen updates daily based on what your coach has scheduled for you
- If no workout is scheduled, the screen will show a rest day message
- Push notifications also remind you about pending tasks
- Pre-workout metrics are optional but help your coach make better decisions

## Common Problems

**My home screen shows no workout**
Your coach may not have scheduled a workout for today. This is normal on rest days. Check the Training tab for upcoming workouts.

**I do not see any check-ins or habits**
Your coach needs to assign these to you first. If you think something is missing, message your coach.

---

## FAQs

**Can I see tomorrow's workout?**
Yes. Go to the **Training** tab and navigate to the next day.

**What happens if I skip the pre-workout metrics?**
You can still start the workout. The metrics are optional but recommended.

**Can I rearrange items on the home screen?**
No. The home screen layout is fixed and shows items based on what your coach has assigned.

# Client App: Viewing and Completing Workouts

## What is this?

The Training tab shows your weekly workout calendar. You can see what workouts your coach has scheduled, preview exercises, and complete guided workout sessions with built-in tracking.

## Why it is useful

Your coach plans your training so you do not have to. The app walks you through each exercise with video demos, tracks your sets and reps, and sends your results back to your coach automatically.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Weekly Schedule

1. Tap the **Training** tab
2. You see a weekly calendar with dots on days that have workouts
3. Tap a day to see the workout assigned
4. Days without workouts are rest days

> [Screenshot: Training tab weekly calendar with workout indicators]

### Previewing a Workout

1. Tap a day that has a workout
2. The workout preview shows all exercises, sets, reps, and any notes from your coach
3. Each exercise shows the target muscles and has a video demo you can watch
4. Scroll through to see the full session before starting

> [Screenshot: Workout preview showing exercise list with sets and reps]

### Starting a Workout Session

1. On the workout preview, tap **Start Workout**
2. You may be asked to rate your pre-workout metrics (sleep, mood, energy, stress, soreness)
3. The app guides you through each exercise one at a time
4. For each set:
   - Log the weight you used
   - Log the reps you completed
   - Tap **Complete Set** to move to the next one
5. Rest timers start automatically between sets if configured

> [Screenshot: Active workout session showing current exercise with set logging]

### Viewing Exercise Demos

1. During a workout, tap the **video icon** on any exercise
2. A demonstration video plays showing proper form
3. Close the video to return to your session

> [Screenshot: Exercise video demo playing during workout]

### Completing a Workout

1. After finishing all exercises, tap **Complete Workout**
2. You may be asked for post-workout feedback (rating, notes)
3. Your results are saved and sent to your coach
4. The workout shows as completed on your calendar

> [Screenshot: Workout completion screen with feedback option]

### Viewing Past Workouts

1. On the Training tab, navigate to a past day
2. Tap the completed workout to see your logged results
3. Compare your performance across weeks

> [Screenshot: Completed workout showing logged weights and reps]

## Things to Note

- Your coach can see everything you log in real time
- If you skip a set or exercise, it still counts toward your workout data
- You can pause a workout and come back to it later
- Workout notes from your coach appear next to each exercise

## Common Problems

**The workout is not showing for today**
Your coach may not have scheduled one. Check with them if you expected a workout.

**I logged the wrong weight or reps**
You can edit individual sets during the session. After completing, ask your coach to adjust if needed.

**The app crashed during my workout**
Reopen the app. Your progress should be saved. If not, manually log your remaining sets.

---

## FAQs

**Can I do the exercises in a different order?**
The app presents exercises in the order your coach set. You can scroll ahead if needed.

**Can I add my own exercises to the workout?**
No. Only your coach can modify the workout content.

**Do I need internet to do a workout?**
You need internet to start the session and sync results. Brief disconnections during the workout should not cause data loss.

**What if I cannot complete all the sets?**
Log what you did. Your coach will see the partial completion and can adjust future workouts.

**Can I repeat a workout from a previous day?**
Each workout is tied to a specific day. Ask your coach if you want to redo a session.

# Client App: Progress Tracking

## What is this?

The Progress tab is your personal dashboard for tracking how you are improving over time. It brings together your metrics, exercise history, and overall trends so you can see the bigger picture of your fitness journey.

## Why it is useful

Day to day it can be hard to see progress. The Progress tab gives you charts and data that show how far you have come. Seeing your squat go up by 20kg over 3 months or your body weight trend downward is powerful motivation.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Progress Overview

1. Tap the **Progress** tab at the bottom of the screen
2. You see a summary of your tracked metrics and recent activity
3. Scroll to explore different data points

> [Screenshot: Progress tab overview with summary cards]

### Viewing Metric Charts

1. On the Progress tab, tap any metric (e.g., Body Weight, Body Fat)
2. A chart shows your values over time
3. Swipe left and right to change the time range
4. Tap individual data points to see exact values and dates

> [Screenshot: Metric chart showing body weight trend over 3 months]

### Viewing Exercise History

1. On the Progress tab, navigate to **Exercise History**
2. Browse or search for a specific exercise
3. Tap an exercise to see your performance history
4. View charts showing weight, reps, and volume progression over time

> [Screenshot: Exercise history list with search bar]

### Viewing Exercise Detail Charts

1. After selecting an exercise, you see a chart of your best sets
2. Below the chart is a log of every time you performed that exercise
3. Each entry shows the date, sets, reps, and weights used
4. This helps you and your coach track strength progression

> [Screenshot: Exercise detail page with performance chart and log history]

### Comparing Progress Over Time

1. Use the date range controls to zoom in or out on your data
2. Compare current metrics to where you started
3. Share your progress with your coach through the chat if you want to celebrate a win

> [Screenshot: Progress comparison showing start vs current values]

## Things to Note

- Progress data comes from your workout logs and metric entries
- The more consistently you log your workouts, the more useful the charts become
- Your coach can also see all your progress data from their side
- Exercise history only shows exercises you have actually completed (not just assigned)

## Common Problems

**My progress charts are empty**
You need to complete workouts and log your sets with weights and reps. Charts populate as data is recorded over time.

**An exercise is missing from my history**
Make sure you completed the workout containing that exercise and logged your sets. Skipped exercises do not appear in history.

**The numbers do not look right**
Double check the units (kg vs lbs). If you logged incorrect values during a workout, ask your coach to help correct them.

---

## FAQs

**How far back does my history go?**
All data from when you started using the app is stored and accessible.

**Can I see my progress for a specific time period?**
Yes. Use the date range controls on charts to focus on a specific window.

**Can my coach see my progress data?**
Yes. Your coach has full access to your metrics, exercise history, and progress charts.

**Can I export my progress data?**
Export options depend on the features available. Ask your coach if you need data exported.

**What counts as "progress"?**
Any data you log: workout performance (weights, reps), metric values (body weight, measurements), and habit completion rates.

# Client App: Messaging Your Coach

## What is this?

The Chats tab lets you message your coach directly from the app. Send text, photos, videos, files, and audio messages all in one place.

## Why it is useful

Having all your coaching communication in one app means you do not need to search through WhatsApp or email for that nutrition plan your coach sent last week. Everything stays organized and connected to your coaching experience.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Opening Your Chat

1. Tap the **Chats** tab at the bottom of the screen
2. Tap your coach's conversation
3. You see your full message history

> [Screenshot: Client chats tab showing conversation with coach]

### Sending a Message

1. Type your message in the input field at the bottom
2. Tap **Send**
3. Your coach receives a notification

> [Screenshot: Chat conversation with message input field]

### Sending Photos and Files

1. Tap the **attachment** icon next to the input field
2. Choose from:
   - **Camera** to take a new photo
   - **Photo Library** to select existing photos
   - **Files** to share a document
3. Add an optional caption
4. Tap **Send**

> [Screenshot: Attachment options showing camera, photo library, and files]

### Sending Audio Messages

1. Tap and hold the **microphone** icon
2. Record your message
3. Release to send

> [Screenshot: Audio message recording indicator]

### Reacting to Messages

1. Long press on any message
2. Select an emoji reaction
3. The reaction appears on the message

> [Screenshot: Message with reaction emoji options]

### Viewing Shared Media

1. In a conversation, you can scroll back through shared photos, videos, and files
2. Tap any media to view it full screen
3. Download files to your device if needed

> [Screenshot: Shared media viewer in chat]

## Things to Note

- Messages sync in real time between your app and your coach's web/mobile app
- Push notifications alert you when your coach sends a message
- You can send up to 4 files per message
- Message history is preserved even if you log out and back in

## Common Problems

**My message is not sending**
Check your internet connection. Try closing and reopening the app.

**I cannot see photos my coach sent**
Make sure the app has permission to access your photos and storage. Check your device settings.

**I am not getting notifications for new messages**
Go to your device settings and make sure notifications are enabled for Athli. Also check in-app notification settings.

---

## FAQs

**Can I delete a message I sent?**
Yes. Long press on your message and select delete.

**Can I message my coach at any time?**
Yes. Your coach will respond when they are available. Messages are delivered instantly.

**Is my chat private?**
Yes. Only you and your coach can see your conversation.

**Can I share my workout results in the chat?**
You can send screenshots or describe your results. Your coach also sees your workout data directly in their app.

# Client App: Submitting Check-ins

## What is this?

Check-ins are recurring forms your coach assigns to you. They ask about how you are feeling, your recovery, nutrition, or other aspects of your training. You fill them out on a regular schedule (daily, weekly, etc.) and your coach reviews your responses.

## Why it is useful

Check-ins give your coach insight into how you are doing beyond just your workouts. Maybe your sleep has been poor, your stress is high, or your nutrition has been off track. This information helps your coach adjust your training and provide better support.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Finding Your Pending Check-ins

1. Open the app to the **Home** tab
2. Pending check-ins appear as a task card
3. You may also receive a push notification when a check-in is due
4. Tap the check-in to open it

> [Screenshot: Home screen showing pending check-in notification card]

### Filling Out a Check-in

1. Tap the check-in to open the form
2. Answer each question:
   - **Text questions** - type your answer
   - **Rating questions** - select a value on the scale
   - **Yes/No questions** - tap your answer
   - **Multiple choice** - select one or more options
   - **Number questions** - enter a value
3. Scroll through all questions
4. Tap **Submit** when done

> [Screenshot: Check-in form with different question types being filled out]

### Viewing Past Check-in Submissions

1. Navigate to your **Check-ins** section (from Home or Profile)
2. You see a list of all your past submissions with dates
3. Tap any submission to review your answers

> [Screenshot: Check-in history list with past submissions]

## Things to Note

- Check-ins have a schedule set by your coach (daily, weekly, biweekly, or monthly)
- Submitting on time helps your coach stay informed and make timely adjustments
- You can submit a check-in late if you missed the due date
- Once submitted, you cannot edit your responses
- Your coach can compare your check-ins over time to spot trends

## Common Problems

**I do not see any check-ins**
Your coach needs to assign them first. If you think one is missing, message your coach.

**I accidentally submitted before finishing**
Unfortunately, submissions are final. Let your coach know and they can take note of any missing information.

**The check-in notification did not appear**
Make sure push notifications are enabled for Athli in your device settings.

---

## FAQs

**How often do I need to submit check-ins?**
This depends on what your coach has set up. Common schedules are daily or weekly.

**Can I see what my coach thinks of my check-in?**
Your coach may follow up in the chat with feedback based on your check-in responses.

**Do I have to answer every question?**
Questions marked as required must be answered. Optional questions can be skipped.

**What if I forget to submit?**
Your coach will be able to see that a check-in was missed. Try to submit as soon as you remember.

source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "client-mobile"

# Client App: Daily Habit Tracking

## What is this?

Habits are daily tasks your coach assigns to help you build consistency. Things like drinking enough water, hitting your protein target, getting enough sleep, or doing your mobility routine. You mark each habit as done each day.

## Why it is useful

Big results come from small daily actions. Habit tracking keeps you accountable and helps your coach see how consistent you are outside of your workouts. Over time, you build routines that support your training goals.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Habits

1. On the **Home** tab, your assigned habits appear as daily tasks
2. Each habit shows its name and whether you have completed it today
3. You can also find habits in your profile section

> [Screenshot: Home screen showing daily habits with checkboxes]

### Logging a Habit

1. Tap the habit you want to log
2. Tap **Complete** or check the box to mark it as done for today
3. The habit updates immediately

> [Screenshot: Habit being marked as complete with checkmark animation]

### Viewing Your Habit History

1. Navigate to your habits section
2. You see a calendar or streak view showing which days you completed each habit
3. This helps you see your consistency patterns over time

> [Screenshot: Habit history showing completion calendar with streaks]

## Things to Note

- Habits reset each day so you need to log them daily
- Your coach can see your habit completion rates
- Consistent habit completion helps your coach understand your commitment level
- Push notifications can remind you about daily habits

## Common Problems

**I forgot to log a habit yesterday**
Ask your coach if they can log it on your behalf. You may not be able to log for past dates.

**I do not have any habits assigned**
Your coach needs to set them up. Message your coach if you think habits would help you.

---

## FAQs

**Can I add my own habits?**
No. Habits are assigned by your coach to keep your tracking aligned with your coaching plan.

**Do habits count on rest days?**
Yes. Habits like nutrition, sleep, and water intake apply every day, not just training days.

**Can I see my weekly or monthly completion rate?**
Your habit history shows daily completion. Your coach can see overall adherence rates.

**What happens if I miss a day?**
Nothing bad happens in the app. The day simply shows as incomplete. Try to stay consistent.

# Client App: Logging Metrics

## What is this?

Metrics are numerical values your coach asks you to track over time. Things like body weight, body fat percentage, waist measurement, or any custom data point your coach sets up. You log values regularly and the app shows your trend in a chart.

## Why it is useful

Numbers do not lie. Tracking metrics gives you and your coach an objective view of your progress. Even when the mirror or the scale feels discouraging day to day, charts showing a 3-month trend tell a much more accurate story.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Assigned Metrics

1. Navigate to the **Progress** tab or your metrics section
2. You see a list of all metrics your coach has assigned
3. Each metric shows the latest value and when it was last logged

> [Screenshot: Metrics list showing assigned metrics with latest values]

### Logging a Metric Value

1. Tap the metric you want to log (e.g., Body Weight)
2. Enter the value
3. The date defaults to today but you can change it if needed
4. Tap **Save**
5. The new value appears on your chart immediately

> [Screenshot: Metric logging screen with value input and save button]

### Viewing Your Metric Charts

1. Tap any metric to see its chart
2. The chart shows all your logged values over time as a trend line
3. Tap individual points to see exact values and dates
4. Use the time range to zoom in on specific periods

> [Screenshot: Metric chart showing body weight trend with data points]

### Logging Multiple Metrics

If your coach has assigned several metrics, you can log them one after another:

1. Log the first metric and save
2. Go back to the list and tap the next one
3. Repeat until all are logged

> [Screenshot: Metrics list with some showing "logged today" indicators]

## Things to Note

- Log metrics at the same time of day for consistent data (e.g., body weight first thing in the morning)
- Your coach can see all your logged values and charts
- The more data points you log, the more useful the trend charts become
- One or two data points will not show a meaningful trend. Aim for at least a few weeks of data

## Common Problems

**My chart is not showing a trend line**
You need at least two data points to see a trend. Keep logging regularly.

**I entered the wrong value**
Contact your coach to correct it. They can edit or delete log entries from their side.

**I am not sure what unit to use**
Check the metric description set by your coach. It will specify if values should be in kg, lbs, cm, inches, etc.

---

## FAQs

**How often should I log my metrics?**
Follow your coach's guidance. Common frequencies are daily (for weight) or weekly (for measurements).

**Can I log a metric for a past date?**
Yes. When logging a value, you can change the date before saving.

**Can I see my starting value vs current value?**
Yes. The chart shows your full history. Scroll to the beginning to see where you started.

**What is the difference between metrics and habits?**
Habits are binary (done or not done). Metrics are numbers that you track over time (like weight or measurements).


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "client-mobile"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Client App: Progress Photos

## What is this?

Progress photos let you take and upload photos on a regular basis to visually document your transformation. Your coach can view your photos and compare them across different dates.

## Why it is useful

The scale does not always reflect reality. You might be building muscle while losing fat, which means the number stays the same but your body looks completely different. Progress photos capture changes that numbers miss and are one of the most motivating tools in your fitness journey.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Taking a Progress Photo

1. Navigate to the **Progress Photos** section
2. Tap **Take Photo** or **Add Photo**
3. Use your camera to take a new photo, or select one from your photo library
4. The photo is saved and tagged with today's date
5. Tap **Save**

> [Screenshot: Progress photo capture screen with camera and library options]

### Viewing Your Photos

1. Go to the Progress Photos section
2. You see your photos organized by date
3. Tap any date to view the photos from that day
4. Swipe through multiple photos if you took more than one

> [Screenshot: Photo timeline showing photos organized by date]

### Comparing Photos

1. In the Progress Photos section, tap **Compare**
2. Select two dates to compare side by side
3. Your photos from each date appear next to each other
4. This makes it easy to see visual changes over time

> [Screenshot: Side-by-side photo comparison with two different dates]

### Tips for Better Progress Photos

- Take photos at the same time of day (morning is best)
- Use the same lighting and background each time
- Wear the same or similar clothing
- Take front, side, and back shots for a full picture
- Stay consistent with your photo schedule (weekly or biweekly works well)

## Things to Note

- Your photos are private and only visible to you and your coach
- Photos are stored securely in the cloud
- Try to keep a consistent schedule for the most useful comparisons
- Image files should be under 5MB

## Common Problems

**My photo is not uploading**
Check your internet connection and make sure the file is under 5MB. Try taking a new photo with the in-app camera.

**I want to delete a photo**
Open the photo and look for the delete option. Be careful as this cannot be undone.

**The comparison does not look right**
Make sure you are comparing photos taken in similar conditions (lighting, pose, clothing).

---

## FAQs

**Can my coach see all my progress photos?**
Yes. Your coach has access to your photos for tracking purposes.

**How often should I take progress photos?**
Once a week or every two weeks is a good frequency. Monthly is fine for slower body composition changes.

**Can I add photos from my camera roll?**
Yes. You can select existing photos from your device when adding a progress photo.

**Are my photos backed up?**
Yes. Photos are stored in the cloud and accessible even if you switch devices.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source: "https://docs.tryathli.com"
section: "client-mobile"

# Client App: Profile and Settings

## What is this?

The Profile tab lets you manage your personal details, view your coaching information, adjust app settings, and control notifications.

## Why it is useful

Keeping your profile up to date helps your coach personalize your training. Settings let you control how the app works for you, from notifications to security preferences.

## Step-by-Step Guide

### Viewing Your Profile

1. Tap the **Profile** tab at the bottom of the screen
2. You see your name, profile picture, and coaching information
3. Below that are links to your goals, injuries, and personal details

> [Screenshot: Client profile screen showing name, photo, and info sections]

### Editing Your Profile

1. On the Profile tab, tap **Edit Profile**
2. Update your name or profile picture
3. Tap **Save**

> [Screenshot: Edit profile screen with name and photo fields]

### Viewing Your Goals and Injuries

1. On the Profile tab, tap **Goals** or **Injuries**
2. See the goals your coach has set or that you have discussed together
3. Injuries are tracked so your coach can program around them

> [Screenshot: Goals section showing active fitness goals]

### Managing Notifications

1. On the Profile tab, tap **Settings** or **Notifications**
2. Toggle push notifications on or off for different types:
   - New messages from your coach
   - Workout reminders
   - Check-in reminders
   - Habit reminders
3. Make sure notifications are also enabled in your device system settings

> [Screenshot: Notification settings with toggle switches for each type]

### Enabling Biometric Lock

1. Go to **Settings** from the Profile tab
2. Find the **Security** or **Biometric Lock** option
3. Enable Face ID or fingerprint lock
4. The app will require biometric verification when you open it

> [Screenshot: Security settings with biometric lock toggle]

### Changing Your Password

1. Go to **Settings > Security**
2. Tap **Change Password**
3. Enter your current password and your new password
4. Tap **Save**

> [Screenshot: Change password screen]

### Logging Out

1. Go to **Settings** from the Profile tab
2. Scroll to the bottom
3. Tap **Log Out**
4. Confirm the action

> [Screenshot: Settings screen with log out button at bottom]

## Things to Note

- Your coach can also update some of your profile details from their side
- Keeping your timezone accurate helps with workout scheduling and check-in reminders
- Biometric lock adds an extra layer of privacy for your coaching data
- Logging out does not delete your data. You can log back in at any time

## Common Problems

**I cannot change my email address**
Email changes need to be verified. If you are having issues, contact your coach or support.

**Push notifications are not working**
Check both the in-app settings and your device system settings. Make sure Athli is allowed to send notifications. On Android, also check battery optimization settings as they can block notifications.

**I forgot my password**
On the login screen, tap **Forgot Password** and follow the reset steps.

---

## FAQs

**Can I delete my account?**
Contact your coach or support to request account deletion.

**Can I change my coach?**
Your account is linked to one coach. To switch coaches, your new coach would need to invite you to their account.

**Is my data private?**
Yes. Your data is only visible to you and your coach. It is not shared with other clients or third parties.

**Can I use the app on multiple devices?**
Yes. Log in with your credentials on any device and your data syncs automatically.

**What happens if my coach deactivates my account?**
You will lose access to the app. Your data is preserved and can be restored if the coach reactivates your account.
